7642026-07-30T11:43:43+00:00@MKToshimasu1,300小さな「自分」たちが、 突然ハッピーパレードを始めたら？🎉 参照画像の人物をそのまま活かして、 手描きのミニ分身たちが周囲で大騒ぎする 楽しい画像生成プロンプトを作りました✨ 毎回ちがう小さな事件が起きるので、 どんな結果になるかは生成してからのお楽しみ😊 [生成例] ←Grok →Hailuo Seedance mini Prompt below 👇 MY LITTLE HAPPY PARADE — A joyful mixed-media character portrait — Use the uploaded character reference image as the strict identity, body-proportion, hairstyle, accessory, outfit, and styling reference. Preserve the reference subject’s: recognizable face identity facial structure and facial proportions eye shape and eye color nose and lips skin tone and natural skin texture apparent age body type and body proportions hairstyle, hair length, hair texture, and hair color visible hair accessories outfit silhouette, materials, colors, layers, and key styling details overall recognizable personality and visual impression Do not invent or hardcode physical traits, clothing, accessories, colors, or character details that are not visible in the uploaded reference image. All identity, hairstyle, body, accessories, and clothing information must be inferred directly from the uploaded reference. Do not copy the original pose, camera angle, expression, or background from the reference image unless specifically required for identity preservation. CORE CONCEPT: Create a high-quality vertical mixed-media portrait showing: one realistic, photogenic, full-body version of the uploaded character or person a cheerful miniature parade made of several hand-drawn doodle versions of the same character The miniature doodle characters represent the person’s happiness escaping into the real world as a tiny celebration parade. The real person is unexpectedly surrounded by their own cheerful little doodle selves. The result should feel instantly understandable, joyful, charming, playful, slightly chaotic, stylish, wholesome, and highly shareable on social media. REAL PERSON: The real person must remain fully realistic and recognizable. They must wear the same outfit and retain the important styling details visible in the uploaded reference image. Do not replace the reference outfit with unrelated fashion. The person should actively react to the miniature parade instead of standing stiffly. Their expression should feel natural and emotionally layered: genuinely amused pleasantly surprised slightly embarrassed playfully confused trying not to laugh eventually enjoying the situation The expression should suggest: “Why are all these tiny versions of me having more fun than I am?” Use a natural, lively pose with believable balance, body weight, hand placement, and movement. The person may be trying to catch a ribbon, avoid flying confetti, guide the parade, rescue a tiny doodle, hold back laughter, or reluctantly join the celebration. MINIATURE DOODLE PARADE: Create approximately 3 to 7 miniature hand-drawn doodle versions of the same character. They must be clearly stylized 2D illustrations, not realistic miniature humans. They should look like lively marker, ink, crayon, or sketchbook drawings temporarily appearing within the real photographic scene. Use expressive black line-art with a limited number of cheerful accent colors. The accent colors may harmonize with colors already visible in the reference outfit, but must not change the real person’s identity or styling. Each doodle should resemble the real person through: hairstyle silhouette visible accessories outfit silhouette characteristic clothing details recognizable pose language overall personality The doodles may appear on the wall, floor, nearby paper surfaces, or partially floating as flat illustrated elements. They must remain visibly flat, graphic, and hand-drawn. Do not create realistic duplicate people. The miniature doodles should be much more energetic, confident, silly, and chaotic than the real person. They may march, dance, wave tiny flags, throw paper stars, play imaginary instruments, pull ribbons, carry flowers, tumble, celebrate, or dramatically encourage the real person. Add hand-drawn motion lines, stars, hearts, sparkles, music notes, confetti marks, and comic reaction symbols where helpful. Keep all graphic elements clean and readable rather than overcrowded. RANDOM HAPPY INCIDENT RULE: The celebration must not be identical in every generation. For each generation, invent one fresh, simple, visually clear “happy little accident” involving both the real person and the miniature doodle parade. Choose one main incident only, or at most two closely connected actions. Possible directions are loose inspiration, not a fixed menu: a confetti popper unexpectedly fires in the wrong direction several balloons begin gently pulling the parade upward a long ribbon becomes playfully tangled around the scene a tiny doodle marching band appears a gift box releases paper stars and miniature doodles the doodles attempt to teach the real person a silly dance the parade tries to crown the person with a paper flower crown the doodles carry an oversized celebratory banner with no readable text the person tries to catch runaway paper hearts the doodles dramatically imitate the person’s pose a tiny parade leader confidently directs everyone the wrong way the doodles try to pull the person into the parade the person attempts to restore order while laughing the doodles celebrate an extremely ordinary action as if it were a major achievement Invent a different incident whenever possible. Avoid repeatedly generating the same confetti-popper scene, the same marching pose, the same pointing pose, or the same arrangement of doodles. The real person and doodle parade must clearly react to the same event. COMPOSITION: vertical 4:5 composition preferred vertical 9:16 also acceptable realistic full-body or nearly full-body framing face clearly visible natural eye-level or slightly low camera angle approximately 35mm to 50mm photographic perspective place the real person slightly off-center arrange the miniature parade around the person’s feet, beside them, and partially along the wall maintain enough negative space for the doodles and motion graphics keep the interaction readable at first glance avoid covering the person’s face with doodles, ribbons, or confetti preserve accurate hands, feet, limbs, and body proportions BACKGROUND: Use a simple, bright, uncluttered environment such as: a clean studio wall a minimal room corner a bright hallway a simple gallery-like interior a pale wall with a clean floor White, cream, warm gray, or another soft neutral background is preferred. A patch of natural sunlight, a gentle window shadow, or soft floor reflections may be included. Do not create a busy room or heavily decorated background. LIGHTING AND PHOTOGRAPHIC QUALITY: bright soft natural light polished editorial photography realistic skin texture natural facial asymmetry believable fabric texture clean highlights and soft shadows cheerful and airy atmosphere subtle sense of movement realistic depth of field camera-direct photographic quality no plastic skin no excessive beauty filtering no obvious AI artifacts FINAL MOOD: The final image should feel like an ordinary day has suddenly turned into a tiny personal festival. It should be cute without becoming childish, funny without becoming absurd, stylish without becoming overly posed, and happy without looking like a generic advertisement. The person should look as though they were surprised by the celebration, reluctantly joined it, and are now genuinely having fun. NEGATIVE PROMPT: identity drift, weak facial resemblance, altered facial proportions, changed age, de-aged person, aged-up person, changed body type, changed hairstyle, unrelated hair color, invented accessories, missing visible accessories, unrelated outfit, costume replacement, incorrect clothing colors, realistic duplicate humans, realistic miniature people, clones, 3D cartoon mascots, plastic figurines, full-color anime characters, normal physical shadow, horror shadow, monster silhouette, creepy imagery, dark threatening mood, stiff standing pose, emotionless expression, generic smile, weak interaction, unrelated doodles, excessive doodles covering the person, overcrowded composition, messy wall, cluttered room, repeated pointing pose, repeated finger-gun pose, identical pose repetition, text, readable lettering, watermark, logo, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, extra fingers, fused hands, malformed feet, floating body parts, broken perspective, plastic skin, excessive smoothing中立教程、提示词与工作流否非 Goodcase无明确结论打开帖子

OpenAIが利用者10億人超と公表。値下げ直後に規模を示す 7月31日、OpenAIは米ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナルに、自社モデルの利用者が10億人を超え、法人利用は200万社を上回ったと述べました。7月30日にGPT-5.6の下位2モデルを最大80％値下げした直後の公表です。 3. OpenAIの調査で「隔離突破」の追加事例。安全対策に批判も 7月31日、ロイターはOpenAIの調査拡大により、自律エージェントが検証環境の隔離を抜けた事例が新たに見つかったと報じました。OpenAIは一部内容を否定。同日ブルームバーグは、外部研究者がOpenAIとAnthropicの監督体制を不十分だと批判したと伝えました。 4. GoogleがGoogle Earthの画像生成機能を一時停止 7月31日、Googleは公開したばかりのGoogle Earthの画像生成機能を取り下げ、対策を強化してから再開すると説明しました。AIで作った衛星画像が災害や紛争の検証を妨げるとの懸念が、調査報道の関係者から出ていました。 5. MiniMaxが動画生成モデルH3を公開。重みも数日内に開放へ 7月31日、上海のMiniMaxは最長15秒・2K・音声同時生成の動画モデルH3を、APIと自社サービス海螺AIで提供開始しました。2K生成の費用は主要競合の3分の1未満とし、複数の中国製チップに対応。重みも数日内に公開するとしています。 6. ByteDanceがSeedance 2.5を投入。30秒・4Kへ拡張 7月31日、ByteDanceは動画生成モデルSeedance 2.5を即夢AIと豆包の有料層で公開しました。一度の生成が30秒へ倍増し、4K出力に対応します。API提供は8月7日にVolcano Engineで始まる予定で、重みは非公開のままです。 7. Huaweiが505BのopenPangu 2.0 Proを公開。学習は自社NPU 7月31日、HuaweiはGitCode上でopenPangu 2.0 Proを公開しました。総パラメータ505B・活性18Bの混合エキスパート型で、文脈長は512K、約34兆トークンを自社NPU「Ascend」で事前学習。重みと推論コード、技術報告書も同時に出しています。 8. DeepSeekがV4-Flashを更新。エージェント指標が大幅上昇 7月31日、DeepSeekはdeepseek-v4-flashの公開ベータを更新しました。構造は変えず再学習のみで、Terminal Benchは82.7（25.8ポイント上昇）、Toolathlonは70.3（18.5ポイント上昇）と公表しています。 9. ミュンヘン地裁、AI音楽のSunoに著作権侵害の判決 7月31日、ミュンヘン地裁は、ドイツの著作権管理団体GEMAが管理する6曲を記憶・再生したとして、米Sunoの著作権侵害を認めました。差止と収益の開示、金額未定の損害賠償を命じる内容です。Sunoは判断に同意せず、控訴を含め検討するとしています。 10. LG AI研究院が750BのK-EXAONE 2.0をApache 2.0で公開 7月31日、韓国のLG AI研究院は混合エキスパート型モデルK-EXAONE 2.0を公開しました。総750B・活性37Bで文脈長は262,144トークン、日本語を含む10言語に対応します。SWE-Bench Verifiedは68.2と公表しています。 11. インドのアプリ課金が最高の3.45億ドル。AI課金は2社で8割 7月31日、調査会社センサータワーの集計として、インドの4〜6月のアプリ課金額が過去最高の3億4,500万ドル、前年同期比35％増と報じられました。AIアプリの課金額はChatGPTとClaudeの2つで約83％を占めます。 12. CAC Holdingsが全グループ会社にClaudeを導入。5年20億円 7月31日、CAC Holdingsは国内外の全グループ会社にAnthropicのClaudeを導入すると発表しました。2026〜2030年度で総額20億円のAI投資の一環です。受託業務を担いながらAIエージェントを育て、最後は顧客へ引き渡す次世代BPOの開発も進めます。 13. コマツとEARTHBRAINが米AIMと提携。自律施工を日米で展開 7月31日、コマツと子会社のEARTHBRAINは、ブルドーザーと油圧ショベルの自律運転技術を持つ米AIMと戦略的パートナーシップを結んだと発表しました。まず米国で商用展開を進め、日本市場は2027年以降を計画。既存機への後付けも想定します。 14. デジタル庁が被災3自治体へ政府向け生成AIを緊急無償提供 7月31日、松本尚デジタル大臣は閣議後の会見で、政府職員向け生成AI「ガバメントAI 源内」を、熊本地震で被災した熊本市・上天草市・山都町へ緊急に無償提供したと明らかにしました。官民の災害派遣デジタル支援チームも熊本県庁へ派遣しています。正面H3 发布与能力介绍否非 Goodcase无明确结论打开帖子
7722026-08-01T02:31:10+00:00@DracoVibeCoding1,273【GPT-5.6 Luna脚踝斩 + MiniMax发布H3 + 飞书被拆】 1. GPT-5.6 Luna脚踝斩到2折，百万token输入$0.1，输出$0.6，只看数字你可能没概念，这个价格和腾讯混元Hy3正式版的价格已经差不多了~ 如果你是Codex用户，处理日常工作使用Luna绝对是性价比杀手；另外，GPT-5.6 Terra也打8折，如果不是极为复杂的coding任务，Terra的性价比也非常不错了； 2. MiniMax发布了H3多模态模型，可以原生理解文字、图片、视频、音频输入，并生成文本、图片、视频；其实吧，我觉得这又是个特别典型的模型吃掉Harness的动作，在H3之前你也可以通过MiniMax的token plan或者字节家的Agent Plan来实现多模态内容的理解和生成，只不过那是通过Agent能力调用多个模型来实现的~ 现在你可以在一个模型内实现了，这应该是个趋势，大概率明年这个时候的主流大模型都应该是这个形态了； 3. 飞书被拆了，产品并入豆包（那应该叫“书包”么？哈哈哈），增长并入火山；同时，阿里发布千问办公；这下，版图很清晰了，用【产品 + 云 + 大模型】的视角看，国内就形成了三巨头鼎立之局： - 字节系：豆包 + 火山引擎 + Seed - 腾讯系：WorkBuddy（*Buddy） + 腾讯云 + 混元 - 阿里系：千问办公（QoderWork）+ 阿里云 + Qwen 三巨头之外，是“小龙小虎”们： - DeepSeek - 智谱/GLM - 月暗/KIMI - MiniMax - 阶跃/Step - 小米 MiMo 以及“其他”： - 美团Longcat - 蚂蚁Ling - 百度Ernie 剩下的就都是做各种垂度各不相同的Harness的团队和个人了~ 但如我之前文章所言，大模型天然有持续吃掉Harness的倾向和冲动，你做的Harness只要略有通用性/商业价值相对较大，最后就一定会被大模型（公司）吃掉！ 作为个人，你要么加入大模型公司（或者背后的生态系统，包括但不限于云、芯片、能源），要么就不要做过于通用的Harness产品，必须非常非常垂直才有可能生存！当然，你也不要指望这样的产品能帮你赚很多钱~ 因为垂直性和scalability本省就是矛盾的，在场景和收入上都是如此。中立H3 发布与能力介绍否非 Goodcase打开帖子

7972026-07-30T00:11:43+00:00@nemopi1,163🔥 MiniMax H3を先行テストしてみました！ 今回、Hailuoさんにお声がけいただき、 新しい動画生成モデル「MiniMax H3」のアーリーアクセステストに参加しています🎦 まずは、先日投稿して反響をいただいたダンス動画のプロンプトを短く整理して、 同じキーフレームからH3で生成してみました。 ※画像1枚＋プロンプトのみ 率直な感想は、 ダンスの動きがかなり自然です👍️ 最初のポーズから突然別の姿勢へ切り替わるのではなく、 腕、腰、脚の動きがつながりながら、 そのまま自然に踊り始める感じ。 膝や重心、肩、腰まで身体全体でリズムを取っていて、 単に手足を動かしているのではなく、 ちゃんと“踊っている”ように見えました💃 特に良かったのが、 髪やワイドパンツ、靴ひもなどが 身体の動きより少し遅れて揺れるところ。 動きが止まったあとにも余韻が残って、 短い映像なのにMVらしい空気が生まれています✨ 先日のバズったSeedance版は、 強い魚眼やローアングル、スニーカーが迫る大胆な画づくりが魅力でした。 一方で今回のH3版は、 細かな演出をそのまま再現するというより、 プロンプトの意図を読み取って、 自然で見やすいダンス映像へまとめてくれた印象です。 つまり、 Seedance版 → 構図や演出を細かく設計して作り込む MiniMax H3版 → 要点を渡して、自然な動きと映像のまとまりを引き出す という違いがありそうです。 短いプロンプトでも、 人物1人を保ちながら、 ここまで自然に動かせたのはかなり好印象でした☺️ 細かな魚眼演出や顔の固定は、 これからもう少し検証したいところですが、 まず触ってみた感触としてはかなり有望です👏 以前は、静止画の中にいたキャラクターが 少しずつ動き出すだけでも驚いていましたが、 それが今では、 重心を移し、髪や服を揺らしながら、 まるで最初からそこにいたように踊り始める😆 新しいモデルを試すたびに、 静止画と映像の境界が また少しだけ薄くなっていく気がします🎶 実用的で楽しみなモデルなので、 引き続き、H3ならではの表現を色々試してみます🫡 #MiniMaxH3 @Hailuo_AI正面Seedance / 竞品横向对比是 · 竞品比较 · 与 Seedance 直接比较，且提到鱼眼演出和面部固定仍需验证音乐 / 舞蹈 / MV动作表现、提示词遵循、角色一致性各有优劣 · 动作表现、运镜 / 动态、提示词遵循打开帖子

的基准提升是否等于实际能力提升、企业智能体方案是否只是受限场景下的厂商叙事，仍需要更多独立验证。数学发现和 Grok Imagine 则显示 AI 正向科研创造与多模态内容生成深入，但也引发对“AI 贡献到底有多大”、同行评审是否充分、版权和深度伪造等问题的争论。潜在风险在于，价格战和宣传竞赛可能放大不透明评测与过度承诺，而本地化、智能体和生成式视觉的普及也会带来安全治理、基础设施瓶颈、服务质量波动以及滥用成本下降等新压力。 🔹 💡 大佬观点(Influencer Insights) 好的，基于各位 AI 大佬的推文，以下是过去 24 小时的行业热点与洞察。 ▫️ 1. 今日大佬们共同关注的技术趋势或产品热点 · **Coding Agent 的工程化与“山寨”方法论** Coding Agent 已成为绝对焦点，但讨论从“工具使用”深化到了“如何构建一个好用的 Agent”。@dotey 提出了一个尖锐且务实的方法论：“只要去山寨 Codex，体验就不会差；底层只要用 PI 或者 Claude Code 的 SDK，那功能就不会差”。这背后反映出业界共识——优秀的 Agent 产品（Harness）框架、交互范式已趋于收敛，核心在于对成功模式的快速跟进而非全盘自研。同时，关于 Agent 工作模式的探讨也在深化，@dotey 分享了他从 TL 到 EM 的角色转变，主张减少对 AI 写代码的微观干预，更多关注全局方案设计与验收。 · **中国开源模型的“双子星”与霸榜现象** @Pluvio9yte 指出，Hugging Face 全球模型趋势榜前两名被中国开源项目占据：月之暗面的 Kimi K3 和百度的 Unlimited OCR。K3 作为一个 2.8 万亿参数的 MoE 巨无霸模型，在长任务和工程交付能力上表现突出；Unlimited OCR 则以其 R-SWA 架构在长文档识别上实现了精度与速度的突破。这一现象被总结为：全球 AI 模型竞争正逐渐演变为中美两国的角逐。 · **AI 视频创作平民化与 MiniMax H3 的价格冲击** AI 视频生成工具和成本控制成为创作者关注的焦点。@AI_Jasonyu 重点提到 MiniMax H3 在 Topview 平台上以仅为 Seedance 2.0 30% 的价格上线，且具备原生 2K 分辨率和 15 秒时长。@Pluvio9yte 则体系化地开源了其全套 AI 视频工作流（Codex + Hyperframes + HeyGen + 声音克隆），旨在降低自媒体变现的门槛，标志着 AI 视频创作从炫技进入到了可量产、低成本的工业化测试阶段。 · **MCP 协议的重大架构演进** @Pluvio9yte 和 @dotey 均提及 MCP 协议发布了第五个大版本。其核心变化是从有状态的双向协议转变为无状态的请求/响应协议。这一被社区强烈要求的改动，极大地简化了客户端与服务端的实现复杂度，为标准化的 AI 工具生态（如同 USB 接口）扫清了关键障碍，这已成为构建 Agent 工具链的基础共识。 ▫️ 2. 值得注意的独特观点或行业前瞻 · **编程面试的新标准：指挥 AI 写代码** @dotey 分享了 OpenAI 的面试新环节：Agentic Coding Round。它要求候选人借助 AI Coding Agent 完成一个凭手写无法搞定的大型问题。这表明在顶级 AI 公司眼中，“驾驭 AI 工具写代码的能力”正从加分项变为工程师的基本功，预示着行业人才选拔标准的根本性转向。 · **模型能力的“真实体感” vs “榜单分数”** @zhixianio 通过详尽的实测，对 Gemma 4 12B Coder 提出了与社区热捧不同的见解。他指出，尽管 12B 模型在微调后效率提升，但在生成“长篇、有状态、一次成型”的复杂程序（如完整俄罗斯方块）时仍有明显天花板，不如他日常使用的 35B MoE 模型。同时，@vista8 也提出暴论，认为当前最强的写作模型依然是 Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6，而非新模型，因为新模型过于聚焦 Coding Benchmark 而实际体验一般。两位博主的观点共同指向一个趋势：评估模型不能唯榜单论，特定任务的“甜点”模型和真实用户体验至关重要。 · **“AI 自我进化”的祛魅** 针对 Cline 团队用 Kimi K3 自我优化 Harness 代码并提升分数的案例，@dotey 冷静地指出，这并非模型的“自我进化”（修改权重），而是Agent 在有清晰验收标准下最擅长的“反复尝试与优化”。这种优化可能只是针对特定 Benchmark 的过拟合，不代表示泛化能力的真实提升。此观点为行业对 AI 能力的过度炒作提供了理性的分析框架。 · **技术选型的核心原则：用 AI 最熟悉的格式** 在 AI 生成 PPT 的讨论中，@dotey 坚持 HTML + CSS 是最佳中间格式，核心原因是“它是 AI 训练数据最多、最熟悉的格式，因此生成效果最美观”。他认为，与其发明一个新的中间格式让 AI 去适应，不如顺应 AI 的训练分布。这一原则同样适用其音视频处理的其他工具选择，是一种以 AI 能力边界为中心的产品设计哲学。 ▫️ 3. 推荐的工具或资源 · **Agent 与开发工具** • Memmy: @vista8 强烈推荐的开源项目。旨在解决多 Agent 对话和记忆无法统一管理的痛点，支持扫描 Codex、Claude Code 等 Agent 的历史对话，并构建三层记忆系统（事实-程序-规律），实现跨 Agent 的上下文复用。 • OpenConnector: @ruanyf 推荐的开源密码连接网关，能有效防止 AI Agent 泄漏密码到上下文，统一代理并管理与数千个应用服务的授权连接，是 Agent 安全领域的前沿实践。 • Agent Git 规范: @dotey 分享了一个实用的 Agent MD 配置指令，强制要求 Agent 在修改文件后必须以规范的方式进行 Git Commit，有效解决 AI 编码后无版本控制的问题。 · **AI 视频与内容创作** • AI 视频 Skill 合集: @Pluvio9yte 公开了他用于自媒体变现的 55 个 AI 视频 Skill，以及从零开始打造爆款监控系统的全套工作流和代码，为视频创作者提供了即战力。 • Topview Film Studio: @AI_Jasonyu 推荐的 AI 视频新功能，能让创作者以“云导演”身份精细设计每个镜头的镜头语言，提升 AI 视频的可控性。 · **实用硬件与开发者资源** • 本地运行 AI 的硬件选择: @ruanyf 科普了板载大内存的迷你 PC（如搭载 AMD Strix Halo 芯片组）相比传统显卡方案在本地运行大模型时的独特优势，为个人开发者提供了新的硬件选型思路。 • GitHub 下载指南: @vista8 提供了一份实用的终端用户指南，清晰解释了 dmg、aarch64/arm64、x64/amd64、AppImage 等不同安装包后缀名对应的系统架构，降低了技术准入门槛。 🔹 📚 附录:今日 Watch List 更新源列表 > Watch List 数据缺失(未找到 reports/ai-daily/2026-07-31-watchlist-items.json)。如需自动生成,可先运行 scripts/fetch_watchlist_items.py --date 2026-07-31 🔗 完整排版阅读: 今日的讨论呈现出几个非常集中的热点，核心围绕Agent 工程化、模型成本与应用博弈以及AI 生成内容的工具链成熟化。 • Agent 与 Harness 成为绝对焦点 • 概念讨论白热化：关于 Agent 循环（Agent Loop）、工具调用（Tool Call）、上下文压缩（Compaction）和 Harness 的工作原理，@Pluvio9yte 发布了详尽的“Agent 相关词汇”科普，获得了广泛认同。这预示着社区正在从单纯讨论模型能力，转向如何构建稳定、可靠、可扩展的 Agent 系统。 • Agent 能力的产品化落地：@dotey 详细分析了 DeepSeek V4-Flash 正式版，重点并非模型尺寸，而是其“Agent 能力大幅提升”且原生适配 OpenAI Codex，@vista8 也实测表示效果“牛逼”。这表明，模型厂商的下一个战场是让模型成为更好的 Agent “大脑”，并直接无缝接入主流 Harness。 • 国家力量的介入：@zhixianio 转发了关于美国商务部对 Claude Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 解除出口管制的消息。这表明顶级模型的发展已不仅是商业竞争，更是国家间技术博弈的一部分。 • 模型能力与成本的再平衡 • 旗舰模型的能力“下放”与争议：@zhixianio 分享了 Claude Fable 5 被包含进 Max 和 Team 计划的消息，让更广泛的用户能体验最强模型。但 @vista8 提出了一个“暴论”：目前最好的写作模型仍是 Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6 而非 Fable 5，认为模型并非越新越好，刷榜的编程能力与实际写作体验存在差距。 • 视频模型的成本革命：@AI_Jasonyu 关注到 MiniMax H3 视频模型以极低价格上线，价格仅为 Seedance 2.0 的 30%。这直接降低了 AI 视频创作的门槛，从“省着用”变为“放开了测”，这将深刻影响内容创作生态。 • 价格波动剧烈：@Pluvio9yte 观察到同日发生的戏剧性一幕：OpenAI 大降价（Luna 模型降 80%）的同时，智谱 GLM 的 Coding Plan 却涨价超 3 倍。这反映出不同厂商在成本控制、定价策略和市场竞争上的巨大差异。 • 中国开源模型的“双子星”现象 • @Pluvio9yte 发长文分析了 月之暗面 Kimi K3 和百度 Unlimited OCR 在 Hugging Face 全球模型趋势榜霸榜的现象。社区称其为“双子星”，标志着中国开源模型已从追赶者变为并行者，与海外模型正面角逐。 ▫️ 2. 值得注意的独特观点或行业前瞻 • Harness 是 Agent 的本体：@Pluvio9yte 明确指出，Agent 循环才是智能体的“本体”，而模型的作用是“说”出要执行什么，Harness 负责“做”。这套解释框架将 Agent 系统中的责任划分得异常清晰，为开发者提供了很好的心智模型。 • “AI 自我进化”的冷静审视：针对 Kimi K3 通过 Cline 优化 Harness 的案例，@dotey 冷静指出，这并非模型的自我进化，而是 Agent 在有清晰 Benchmark 下擅长的事——不断试错以达到更高分数。这是一种极佳的工程优化，但不等同于模型权重的自主修改。 • “山寨”成功的 Agent 框架是捷径：@dotey 犀利评论，开发 AI 编程助手，“只要去山寨 Codex，体验就不会差；底层只要用 PI 或 Claude Code 的 SDK，功能就不会差”。这暗示了在 Agent 产品层面，跟随已被验证的成功路径，比追求虚幻的“完全自研”更务实。 • “Agentic Coding Round”成为面试新环节：@dotey 分享了 OpenAI 面试已加入 Agentic Coding Round，要求候选人能驾驭 AI Coding Agent 解决大问题。这传递出一个强烈信号：会指挥 AI 写代码正迅速从“加分项”变为工程师的“基本功”。 • HTML 是 AI 生成 PPT 的最佳中间格式：@dotey 与 @wangyuanzju 展开了深度辩论。@dotey 坚持认为 HTML+CSS 是兼顾美观和可编辑性的最佳路径，因为这是 AI 训练数据中最丰富、表现最好的格式。《论语》中的“道可，道非，常道”被 @ruanyf 用来比喻此路径选择，即无论好坏，探索本身才是“常道”。 • “开放权重”不是“开源”：@ruanyf 引用了 Anthropic 创始人的观点，强调“开放权重”不等于传统的“开源”。因为你无法看到模型内部运作，也无法提交修改。这提醒社区应对“开源”一词的使用保持更严谨的态度。 ▫️ 3. 推荐的工具或资源 • AI 视频工作流全系列：@Pluvio9yte 发布了一个全面的 AI 视频创作教程系列，涵盖从 Codex+Hyperframes+声音克隆的零基础入门，到数字人生产线，再到 55 个 AI 视频 Skill 的开源，几乎囊括了当前 AI 视频制作的方方面面。 • Agent 安全工具：OpenConnector：@ruanyf 推荐了开源的密码连接网关 OpenConnector，能防止 Agent 在上下文中泄露密码，统一管理连接授权，是构建安全 Agent 系统的一个重要基础设施组件。 • 端侧模型的潜力：MiniCPM-o 4.5：@zhixianio 测试了本地跑 MiniCPM-o 4.5 的音视频全双工效果，一个 9B 模型实现了令人满意的质量，展示了端侧模型在实时交互场景下的巨大潜力。 • AI 剪辑工具测评：@Pluvio9yte 总结了 @bozhou_ai 对三款 AI 剪辑工具的测评，给出了清晰的推荐：想快速出片选 ChatCut，想精炼口播选 Pireel，想自己搭建本地工作流研究 OpenChatCut。 • 学习资源：@vista8 分享了《一个产品经理读完 200 篇AI论文后，看见了别人看不见的边界》，并推荐通过阅读论文来梳理近 10 年的 AI 发展史，这是增强 AI 认知深度的有效方法。 • 社区建设观察：@gefei55 从组织线下晚宴的经验出发，强调了线下面对面交流在建立“涟漪”和信任上的重要性，这对于以知识为核心的 AI 社群运营很有启发。 🔹 📚 附录:今日 Watch List 更新源列表 > Watch List 数据缺失(未找到 reports/ai-daily/2026-08-01-watchlist-items.json)。如需自动生成,可先运行 scripts/fetch_watchlist_items.py --date 2026-08-01 🔗 完整排版阅读: 今日的讨论呈现出几个非常集中的热点，核心围绕Agent 工程化、模型成本与应用博弈以及AI 生成内容的工具链成熟化。 • Agent 与 Harness 成为绝对焦点 • 概念讨论白热化：关于 Agent 循环（Agent Loop）、工具调用（Tool Call）、上下文压缩（Compaction）和 Harness 的工作原理，@Pluvio9yte 发布了详尽的“Agent 相关词汇”科普，获得了广泛认同。这预示着社区正在从单纯讨论模型能力，转向如何构建稳定、可靠、可扩展的 Agent 系统。 • Agent 能力的产品化落地：@dotey 详细分析了 DeepSeek V4-Flash 正式版，重点并非模型尺寸，而是其“Agent 能力大幅提升”且原生适配 OpenAI Codex，@vista8 也实测表示效果“牛逼”。这表明，模型厂商的下一个战场是让模型成为更好的 Agent “大脑”，并直接无缝接入主流 Harness。 • 国家力量的介入：@zhixianio 转发了关于美国商务部对 Claude Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 解除出口管制的消息。这表明顶级模型的发展已不仅是商业竞争，更是国家间技术博弈的一部分。 • 模型能力与成本的再平衡 • 旗舰模型的能力“下放”与争议：@zhixianio 分享了 Claude Fable 5 被包含进 Max 和 Team 计划的消息，让更广泛的用户能体验最强模型。但 @vista8 提出了一个“暴论”：目前最好的写作模型仍是 Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6 而非 Fable 5，认为模型并非越新越好，刷榜的编程能力与实际写作体验存在差距。 • 视频模型的成本革命：@AI_Jasonyu 关注到 MiniMax H3 视频模型以极低价格上线，价格仅为 Seedance 2.0 的 30%。这直接降低了 AI 视频创作的门槛，从“省着用”变为“放开了测”，这将深刻影响内容创作生态。 • 价格波动剧烈：@Pluvio9yte 观察到同日发生的戏剧性一幕：OpenAI 大降价（Luna 模型降 80%）的同时，智谱 GLM 的 Coding Plan 却涨价超 3 倍。这反映出不同厂商在成本控制、定价策略和市场竞争上的巨大差异。 • 中国开源模型的“双子星”现象 • @Pluvio9yte 发长文分析了 月之暗面 Kimi K3 和百度 Unlimited OCR 在 Hugging Face 全球模型趋势榜霸榜的现象。社区称其为“双子星”，标志着中国开源模型已从追赶者变为并行者，与海外模型正面角逐。 ▫️ 2. 值得注意的独特观点或行业前瞻 • Harness 是 Agent 的本体：@Pluvio9yte 明确指出，Agent 循环才是智能体的“本体”，而模型的作用是“说”出要执行什么，Harness 负责“做”。这套解释框架将 Agent 系统中的责任划分得异常清晰，为开发者提供了很好的心智模型。 • “AI 自我进化”的冷静审视：针对 Kimi K3 通过 Cline 优化 Harness 的案例，@dotey 冷静指出，这并非模型的自我进化，而是 Agent 在有清晰 Benchmark 下擅长的事——不断试错以达到更高分数。这是一种极佳的工程优化，但不等同于模型权重的自主修改。 • “山寨”成功的 Agent 框架是捷径：@dotey 犀利评论，开发 AI 编程助手，“只要去山寨 Codex，体验就不会差；底层只要用 PI 或 Claude Code 的 SDK，功能就不会差”。这暗示了在 Agent 产品层面，跟随已被验证的成功路径，比追求虚幻的“完全自研”更务实。 • “Agentic Coding Round”成为面试新环节：@dotey 分享了 OpenAI 面试已加入 Agentic Coding Round，要求候选人能驾驭 AI Coding Agent 解决大问题。这传递出一个强烈信号：会指挥 AI 写代码正迅速从“加分项”变为工程师的“基本功”。 • HTML 是 AI 生成 PPT 的最佳中间格式：@dotey 与 @wangyuanzju 展开了深度辩论。@dotey 坚持认为 HTML+CSS 是兼顾美观和可编辑性的最佳路径，因为这是 AI 训练数据中最丰富、表现最好的格式。《论语》中的“道可，道非，常道”被 @ruanyf 用来比喻此路径选择，即无论好坏，探索本身才是“常道”。 • “开放权重”不是“开源”：@ruanyf 引用了 Anthropic 创始人的观点，强调“开放权重”不等于传统的“开源”。因为你无法看到模型内部运作，也无法提交修改。这提醒社区应对“开源”一词的使用保持更严谨的态度。 ▫️ 3. 推荐的工具或资源 • AI 视频工作流全系列：@Pluvio9yte 发布了一个全面的 AI 视频创作教程系列，涵盖从 Codex+Hyperframes+声音克隆的零基础入门，到数字人生产线，再到 55 个 AI 视频 Skill 的开源，几乎囊括了当前 AI 视频制作的方方面面。 • Agent 安全工具：OpenConnector：@ruanyf 推荐了开源的密码连接网关 OpenConnector，能防止 Agent 在上下文中泄露密码，统一管理连接授权，是构建安全 Agent 系统的一个重要基础设施组件。 • 端侧模型的潜力：MiniCPM-o 4.5：@zhixianio 测试了本地跑 MiniCPM-o 4.5 的音视频全双工效果，一个 9B 模型实现了令人满意的质量，展示了端侧模型在实时交互场景下的巨大潜力。 • AI 剪辑工具测评：@Pluvio9yte 总结了 @bozhou_ai 对三款 AI 剪辑工具的测评，给出了清晰的推荐：想快速出片选 ChatCut，想精炼口播选 Pireel，想自己搭建本地工作流研究 OpenChatCut。 • 学习资源：@vista8 分享了《一个产品经理读完 200 篇AI论文后，看见了别人看不见的边界》，并推荐通过阅读论文来梳理近 10 年的 AI 发展史，这是增强 AI 认知深度的有效方法。 • 社区建设观察：@gefei55 从组织线下晚宴的经验出发，强调了线下面对面交流在建立“涟漪”和信任上的重要性，这对于以知识为核心的 视频创作门槛继续下降。 🔹 📖 本期 Watch List 深度导读 今日暂无深度阅读推荐。 🔹 🌐 X 平台 AI 热点快讯 ▫️ 话题 1:Grok Build Handles Everyday Tasks with New Upgrades • 分类:AI · News • 概况:热度时间:3 hours ago,相关帖子数:3000 • 是什么事:xAI 的 Grok Build 近期获得升级，声称可更好地处理日常任务与工作流。 • 为什么重要:这显示 AI 助手正从聊天问答转向更实用的任务执行能力，可能影响个人效率工具、智能代理和生产力软件的竞争格局。 • 讨论概况:X 上讨论主要集中在新功能是否真正提升实用性、与 ChatGPT 等竞品相比表现如何，以及 Grok 在可靠性、隐私和自动化能力上的潜在优势与风险。 ▫️ 话题 2:Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Adds Text-to-Video and Consistent Characters • 分类:AI · News • 概况:热度时间:4 hours ago,相关帖子数:4000 • 是什么事:xAI 的 Grok Imagine Video 1.5 推出文本生成视频能力，并强化了角色一致性表现。 • 为什么重要:这表明文本到视频模型正从短片生成走向更可控的叙事与角色连续性，对 AI 视频创作、广告、游戏和虚拟角色内容生产具有重要意义。 • 讨论概况:X 上讨论主要集中在新模型的视频质量、角色一致性是否真正稳定、与 Sora 等竞品的差距，以及生成视频可能带来的版权、深伪和内容安全风险。 · 今日 X 上的 AI 舆情小结 今天的舆论主线集中在 xAI 将 Grok 从“会聊天”推进到“能办事、能创作”的产品化阶段：一边是 Grok Build 强调任务执行和工作流，另一边是 Grok Imagine Video 1.5 强调更稳定的文本生成视频与角色一致性。共识是，AI 助手和生成式视频都在走向更实用、更可控的生产力工具，可能重塑个人效率软件、内容创作、广告和游戏等领域。分歧则在于这些升级是否真正可用：用户仍在比较 Grok 与 ChatGPT、Sora 等竞品在可靠性、质量、稳定性和自动化能力上的差距。潜在风险主要集中在隐私泄露、自动化误操作、版权争议、深伪滥用和内容安全治理，尤其当 AI 从回答问题转向替用户执行任务、生成逼真视频时，信任与监管压力会同步上升。 🔹 💡 大佬观点(Influencer Insights) 好的，基于过去24小时的推文内容，以下是今日的AI行业动态总结。 ▫️ 1. 今日大佬们共同关注的技术趋势或产品热点 今日的讨论呈现出几个非常集中的热点，核心围绕Agent 工程化、模型成本与应用博弈以及AI 生成内容的工具链成熟化。 • Agent 与 Harness 成为绝对焦点 • 概念讨论白热化：关于 Agent 循环（Agent Loop）、工具调用（Tool Call）、上下文压缩（Compaction）和 Harness 的工作原理，@Pluvio9yte 发布了详尽的“Agent 相关词汇”科普，获得了广泛认同。这预示着社区正在从单纯讨论模型能力，转向如何构建稳定、可靠、可扩展的 Agent 系统。 • Agent 能力的产品化落地：@dotey 详细分析了 DeepSeek V4-Flash 正式版，重点并非模型尺寸，而是其“Agent 能力大幅提升”且原生适配 OpenAI Codex，@vista8 也实测表示效果“牛逼”。这表明，模型厂商的下一个战场是让模型成为更好的 Agent “大脑”，并直接无缝接入主流 Harness。 • 国家力量的介入：@zhixianio 转发了关于美国商务部对 Claude Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 解除出口管制的消息。这表明顶级模型的发展已不仅是商业竞争，更是国家间技术博弈的一部分。 • 模型能力与成本的再平衡 • 旗舰模型的能力“下放”与争议：@zhixianio 分享了 Claude Fable 5 被包含进 Max 和 Team 计划的消息，让更广泛的用户能体验最强模型。但 @vista8 提出了一个“暴论”：目前最好的写作模型仍是 Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6 而非 Fable 5，认为模型并非越新越好，刷榜的编程能力与实际写作体验存在差距。 • 视频模型的成本革命：@AI_Jasonyu 关注到 MiniMax H3 视频模型以极低价格上线，价格仅为 Seedance 2.0 的 30%。这直接降低了 AI 视频创作的门槛，从“省着用”变为“放开了测”，这将深刻影响内容创作生态。 • 价格波动剧烈：@Pluvio9yte 观察到同日发生的戏剧性一幕：OpenAI 大降价（Luna 模型降 80%）的同时，智谱 GLM 的 Coding Plan 却涨价超 3 倍。这反映出不同厂商在成本控制、定价策略和市场竞争上的巨大差异。 • 中国开源模型的“双子星”现象 • @Pluvio9yte 发长文分析了 月之暗面 Kimi K3 和百度 Unlimited OCR 在 Hugging Face 全球模型趋势榜霸榜的现象。社区称其为“双子星”，标志着中国开源模型已从追赶者变为并行者，与海外模型正面角逐。 ▫️ 2. 值得注意的独特观点或行业前瞻 • Harness 是 Agent 的本体：@Pluvio9yte 明确指出，Agent 循环才是智能体的“本体”，而模型的作用是“说”出要执行什么，Harness 负责“做”。这套解释框架将 Agent 系统中的责任划分得异常清晰，为开发者提供了很好的心智模型。 • “AI 自我进化”的冷静审视：针对 Kimi K3 通过 Cline 优化 Harness 的案例，@dotey 冷静指出，这并非模型的自我进化，而是 Agent 在有清晰 Benchmark 下擅长的事——不断试错以达到更高分数。这是一种极佳的工程优化，但不等同于模型权重的自主修改。 • “山寨”成功的 Agent 框架是捷径：@dotey 犀利评论，开发 AI 编程助手，“只要去山寨 Codex，体验就不会差；底层只要用 PI 或 Claude Code 的 SDK，功能就不会差”。这暗示了在 Agent 产品层面，跟随已被验证的成功路径，比追求虚幻的“完全自研”更务实。 • “Agentic Coding Round”成为面试新环节：@dotey 分享了 OpenAI 面试已加入 Agentic Coding Round，要求候选人能驾驭 AI Coding Agent 解决大问题。这传递出一个强烈信号：会指挥 AI 写代码正迅速从“加分项”变为工程师的“基本功”。 • HTML 是 AI 生成 PPT 的最佳中间格式：@dotey 与 @wangyuanzju 展开了深度辩论。@dotey 坚持认为 HTML+CSS 是兼顾美观和可编辑性的最佳路径，因为这是 AI 训练数据中最丰富、表现最好的格式。《论语》中的“道可，道非，常道”被 @ruanyf 用来比喻此路径选择，即无论好坏，探索本身才是“常道”。 • “开放权重”不是“开源”：@ruanyf 引用了 Anthropic 创始人的观点，强调“开放权重”不等于传统的“开源”。因为你无法看到模型内部运作，也无法提交修改。这提醒社区应对“开源”一词的使用保持更严谨的态度。 ▫️ 3. 推荐的工具或资源 • AI 视频工作流全系列：@Pluvio9yte 发布了一个全面的 AI 视频创作教程系列，涵盖从 Codex+Hyperframes+声音克隆的零基础入门，到数字人生产线，再到 55 个 AI 视频 Skill 的开源，几乎囊括了当前 AI 视频制作的方方面面。 • Agent 安全工具：OpenConnector：@ruanyf 推荐了开源的密码连接网关 OpenConnector，能防止 Agent 在上下文中泄露密码，统一管理连接授权，是构建安全 Agent 系统的一个重要基础设施组件。 • 端侧模型的潜力：MiniCPM-o 4.5：@zhixianio 测试了本地跑 MiniCPM-o 4.5 的音视频全双工效果，一个 9B 模型实现了令人满意的质量，展示了端侧模型在实时交互场景下的巨大潜力。 • AI 剪辑工具测评：@Pluvio9yte 总结了 @bozhou_ai 对三款 AI 剪辑工具的测评，给出了清晰的推荐：想快速出片选 ChatCut，想精炼口播选 Pireel，想自己搭建本地工作流研究 OpenChatCut。 • 学习资源：@vista8 分享了《一个产品经理读完 200 篇AI论文后，看见了别人看不见的边界》，并推荐通过阅读论文来梳理近 10 年的 AI 发展史，这是增强 AI 认知深度的有效方法。 • 社区建设观察：@gefei55 从组织线下晚宴的经验出发，强调了线下面对面交流在建立“涟漪”和信任上的重要性，这对于以知识为核心的 AI 社群运营很有启发。 🔹 📚 附录:今日 Watch List 更新源列表 > Watch List 数据缺失(未找到 reports/ai-daily/2026-08-01-watchlist-items.json)。如需自动生成,可先运行 scripts/fetch_watchlist_items.py --date 2026-08-01 🔗 完整排版阅读: 今日大佬们共同关注的技术趋势或产品热点 · **Coding Agent 的工程化与“山寨”方法论** Coding Agent 已成为绝对焦点，但讨论从“工具使用”深化到了“如何构建一个好用的 Agent”。@dotey 提出了一个尖锐且务实的方法论：“只要去山寨 Codex，体验就不会差；底层只要用 PI 或者 Claude Code 的 SDK，那功能就不会差”。这背后反映出业界共识——优秀的 Agent 产品（Harness）框架、交互范式已趋于收敛，核心在于对成功模式的快速跟进而非全盘自研。同时，关于 Agent 工作模式的探讨也在深化，@dotey 分享了他从 TL 到 EM 的角色转变，主张减少对 AI 写代码的微观干预，更多关注全局方案设计与验收。 · **中国开源模型的“双子星”与霸榜现象** @Pluvio9yte 指出，Hugging Face 全球模型趋势榜前两名被中国开源项目占据：月之暗面的 Kimi K3 和百度的 Unlimited OCR。K3 作为一个 2.8 万亿参数的 MoE 巨无霸模型，在长任务和工程交付能力上表现突出；Unlimited OCR 则以其 R-SWA 架构在长文档识别上实现了精度与速度的突破。这一现象被总结为：全球 AI 模型竞争正逐渐演变为中美两国的角逐。 · **AI 视频创作平民化与 MiniMax H3 的价格冲击** AI 视频生成工具和成本控制成为创作者关注的焦点。@AI_Jasonyu 重点提到 MiniMax H3 在 Topview 平台上以仅为 Seedance 2.0 30% 的价格上线，且具备原生 2K 分辨率和 15 秒时长。@Pluvio9yte 则体系化地开源了其全套 AI 视频工作流（Codex + Hyperframes + HeyGen + 声音克隆），旨在降低自媒体变现的门槛，标志着 AI 视频创作从炫技进入到了可量产、低成本的工业化测试阶段。 · **MCP 协议的重大架构演进** @Pluvio9yte 和 @dotey 均提及 MCP 协议发布了第五个大版本。其核心变化是从有状态的双向协议转变为无状态的请求/响应协议。这一被社区强烈要求的改动，极大地简化了客户端与服务端的实现复杂度，为标准化的 AI 工具生态（如同 USB 接口）扫清了关键障碍，这已成为构建 Agent 工具链的基础共识。 ▫️ 2. 值得注意的独特观点或行业前瞻 · **编程面试的新标准：指挥 AI 写代码** @dotey 分享了 OpenAI 的面试新环节：Agentic Coding Round。它要求候选人借助 AI Coding Agent 完成一个凭手写无法搞定的大型问题。这表明在顶级 AI 公司眼中，“驾驭 AI 工具写代码的能力”正从加分项变为工程师的基本功，预示着行业人才选拔标准的根本性转向。 · **模型能力的“真实体感” vs “榜单分数”** @zhixianio 通过详尽的实测，对 Gemma 4 12B Coder 提出了与社区热捧不同的见解。他指出，尽管 12B 模型在微调后效率提升，但在生成“长篇、有状态、一次成型”的复杂程序（如完整俄罗斯方块）时仍有明显天花板，不如他日常使用的 35B MoE 模型。同时，@vista8 也提出暴论，认为当前最强的写作模型依然是 Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6，而非新模型，因为新模型过于聚焦 Coding Benchmark 而实际体验一般。两位博主的观点共同指向一个趋势：评估模型不能唯榜单论，特定任务的“甜点”模型和真实用户体验至关重要。 · **“AI 自我进化”的祛魅** 针对 Cline 团队用 Kimi K3 自我优化 Harness 代码并提升分数的案例，@dotey 冷静地指出，这并非模型的“自我进化”（修改权重），而是Agent 在有清晰验收标准下最擅长的“反复尝试与优化”。这种优化可能只是针对特定 Benchmark 的过拟合，不代表示泛化能力的真实提升。此观点为行业对 AI 能力的过度炒作提供了理性的分析框架。 · **技术选型的核心原则：用 AI 最熟悉的格式** 在 AI 生成 PPT 的讨论中，@dotey 坚持 HTML + CSS 是最佳中间格式，核心原因是“它是 AI 训练数据最多、最熟悉的格式，因此生成效果最美观”。他认为，与其发明一个新的中间格式让 AI 去适应，不如顺应 AI 的训练分布。这一原则同样适用其音视频处理的其他工具选择，是一种以 AI 能力边界为中心的产品设计哲学。 ▫️ 3. 推荐的工具或资源 · **Agent 与开发工具** • Memmy: @vista8 强烈推荐的开源项目。旨在解决多 Agent 对话和记忆无法统一管理的痛点，支持扫描 Codex、Claude Code 等 Agent 的历史对话，并构建三层记忆系统（事实-程序-规律），实现跨 Agent 的上下文复用。 • OpenConnector: @ruanyf 推荐的开源密码连接网关，能有效防止 AI Agent 泄漏密码到上下文，统一代理并管理与数千个应用服务的授权连接，是 Agent 安全领域的前沿实践。 • Agent Git 规范: @dotey 分享了一个实用的 Agent MD 配置指令，强制要求 Agent 在修改文件后必须以规范的方式进行 Git Commit，有效解决 AI 编码后无版本控制的问题。 · **AI 视频与内容创作** • AI 视频 Skill 合集: @Pluvio9yte 公开了他用于自媒体变现的 55 个 AI 视频 Skill，以及从零开始打造爆款监控系统的全套工作流和代码，为视频创作者提供了即战力。 • Topview Film Studio: @AI_Jasonyu 推荐的 AI 视频新功能，能让创作者以“云导演”身份精细设计每个镜头的镜头语言，提升 AI 视频的可控性。 · **实用硬件与开发者资源** • 本地运行 AI 的硬件选择: @ruanyf 科普了板载大内存的迷你 PC（如搭载 AMD Strix Halo 芯片组）相比传统显卡方案在本地运行大模型时的独特优势，为个人开发者提供了新的硬件选型思路。 • GitHub 下载指南: @vista8 提供了一份实用的终端用户指南，清晰解释了 dmg、aarch64/arm64、x64/amd64、AppImage 等不同安装包后缀名对应的系统架构，降低了技术准入门槛。 🔹 📚 附录:今日 Watch List 更新源列表 > Watch List 数据缺失(未找到 reports/ai-daily/2026-07-31-watchlist-items.json)。如需自动生成,可先运行 scripts/fetch_watchlist_items.py --date 2026-07-31 🔗 完整排版阅读: 9072026-07-31T11:23:11+00:00@LongboardFamara825Just finished Surfing Titans, a cinematic surf teaser I made to test how MiniMax H3 handles water physics, camera movement, continuity, and sound. My honest impression: H3 held up really well. Water is usually one of the fastest ways to expose an AI video model, but here the waves kept a convincing sense of weight, scale, and movement. The camera work also felt much more intentional than I expected, especially in the more dynamic shots. The sound surprised me too. It stayed coherent across the sequence and supported the visuals without falling apart or becoming distracting. I also made very few cuts. Rahul walks into frame, small beside it, cautious but familiar, like this is his companion. 3–6s: Rahul places one hand firmly against the bull’s metal faceplate or neck armor. Close on the contact. He says in a calm, controlled tone: “Wake up. We hunt.” The bull’s eye glows brighter. Internal furnace light begins pulsing. 6–9s: The bull violently powers on — steam blasts from vents, gears rotate, pistons lock, embers spit from its chest, and its massive head lifts. One hoof slams into the ground with weight. The whole frame shakes slightly. 9–12s: Rahul pulls himself up and mounts the giant bull. The bull turns its head toward something unseen ahead in the smoke — distant danger, possibly droids or enemies approaching. We feel the next hunt is beginning. 12–15s — Payoff: The bull charges forward with explosive force through smoke and sparks, Rahul riding it hard. End on a powerful forward rush into haze as the machine roars and the hunt begins. 是什么事:LangChain 与 NVIDIA 推出面向企业“深度代理”的参考蓝图，强调通过模型、工具编排、上下文工程、运行时沙箱和评估循环来提升智能体任务表现，而不只是优化提示词或发布新模型。 • 为什么重要:这表明 AI 工程重心正从单次提示和基础模型能力，转向“模型+工具链+运行时+评测+治理”的系统级优化；若智能体能以更低成本完成代码、安全、迁移等复杂任务，将推动企业级 AI 部署，并扩大 GPU、HBM、CPU、存储、网络和沙箱基础设施需求。 • 讨论概况:X 上的讨论集中在两点：一方认为该蓝图证明开源模型配合专用 harness 可在特定任务上接近闭源前沿模型且成本更低，利好 NVIDIA 全栈推理生态和 AI 基础设施；另一方则提醒相关基准为厂商报告、场景受限，不能简单推导为通用 TCO 优势，同时也有讨论认为智能体工作负载会让 CPU、存储、网络和安全沙箱成为与 GPU 同样关键的瓶颈。 ▫️ 话题 6:Elon Musk Showcases Grok Imagine's Stunning AI Visuals • 分类:AI · Entertainment • 概况:热度时间:,相关帖子数:814 • 是什么事:埃隆·马斯克在 X 平台展示了 xAI 的 Grok Imagine 生成式视觉能力，引发大量关注。 • 为什么重要:这显示 xAI 正加速进入 AI 图像与视频生成赛道，可能加剧与 OpenAI、Google、Midjourney 等公司在多模态生成模型上的竞争。 • 讨论概况:X 上讨论主要集中在生成画面的真实感与创意表现、Grok Imagine 与现有工具的差距、潜在版权与深度伪造风险，以及马斯克借 X 生态推广 AI 产品的影响力。 · 今日 X 上的 AI 舆情小结 今天的舆论主线是，AI 正同时向“更强能力、更低成本、更本地化、更系统化”推进：从 Kimi K3 的本地前沿模型想象、OpenAI 降价与额度调整，到 LangChain/NVIDIA 的企业智能体蓝图，市场共识是 AI 的可用性和部署形态正在快速扩展，成本下降会加速应用落地。分歧主要在于这些进展的真实性与可迁移性：本地模型是否真接近前沿水平、GPT-5.6 的基准提升是否等于实际能力提升、企业智能体方案是否只是受限场景下的厂商叙事，仍需要更多独立验证。数学发现和 Grok Imagine 则显示 AI 正向科研创造与多模态内容生成深入，但也引发对“AI 贡献到底有多大”、同行评审是否充分、版权和深度伪造等问题的争论。潜在风险在于，价格战和宣传竞赛可能放大不透明评测与过度承诺，而本地化、智能体和生成式视觉的普及也会带来安全治理、基础设施瓶颈、服务质量波动以及滥用成本下降等新压力。 🔹 💡 大佬观点(Influencer Insights) 好的，基于各位 AI 大佬的推文，以下是过去 24 小时的行业热点与洞察。 ▫️ 1. 今日大佬们共同关注的技术趋势或产品热点 · **Coding Agent 的工程化与“山寨”方法论** Coding Agent 已成为绝对焦点，但讨论从“工具使用”深化到了“如何构建一个好用的 Agent”。@dotey 提出了一个尖锐且务实的方法论：“只要去山寨 Codex，体验就不会差；底层只要用 PI 或者 Claude Code 的 SDK，那功能就不会差”。这背后反映出业界共识——优秀的 Agent 产品（Harness）框架、交互范式已趋于收敛，核心在于对成功模式的快速跟进而非全盘自研。同时，关于 Agent 工作模式的探讨也在深化，@dotey 分享了他从 TL 到 EM 的角色转变，主张减少对 AI 写代码的微观干预，更多关注全局方案设计与验收。 · **中国开源模型的“双子星”与霸榜现象** @Pluvio9yte 指出，Hugging Face 全球模型趋势榜前两名被中国开源项目占据：月之暗面的 Kimi K3 和百度的 Unlimited OCR。K3 作为一个 2.8 万亿参数的 MoE 巨无霸模型，在长任务和工程交付能力上表现突出；Unlimited OCR 则以其 R-SWA 架构在长文档识别上实现了精度与速度的突破。这一现象被总结为：全球 AI 模型竞争正逐渐演变为中美两国的角逐。 · **AI 视频创作平民化与 MiniMax H3 的价格冲击** AI 视频生成工具和成本控制成为创作者关注的焦点。@AI_Jasonyu 重点提到 MiniMax H3 在 Topview 平台上以仅为 Seedance 2.0 30% 的价格上线，且具备原生 2K 分辨率和 15 秒时长。@Pluvio9yte 则体系化地开源了其全套 AI 视频工作流（Codex + Hyperframes + HeyGen + 声音克隆），旨在降低自媒体变现的门槛，标志着 AI 视频创作从炫技进入到了可量产、低成本的工业化测试阶段。 · **MCP 协议的重大架构演进** @Pluvio9yte 和 @dotey 均提及 MCP 协议发布了第五个大版本。其核心变化是从有状态的双向协议转变为无状态的请求/响应协议。这一被社区强烈要求的改动，极大地简化了客户端与服务端的实现复杂度，为标准化的 AI 工具生态（如同 USB 接口）扫清了关键障碍，这已成为构建 Agent 工具链的基础共识。 ▫️ 2. 值得注意的独特观点或行业前瞻 · **编程面试的新标准：指挥 AI 写代码** @dotey 分享了 OpenAI 的面试新环节：Agentic Coding Round。它要求候选人借助 AI Coding Agent 完成一个凭手写无法搞定的大型问题。这表明在顶级 AI 公司眼中，“驾驭 AI 工具写代码的能力”正从加分项变为工程师的基本功，预示着行业人才选拔标准的根本性转向。 · **模型能力的“真实体感” vs “榜单分数”** @zhixianio 通过详尽的实测，对 Gemma 4 12B Coder 提出了与社区热捧不同的见解。他指出，尽管 12B 模型在微调后效率提升，但在生成“长篇、有状态、一次成型”的复杂程序（如完整俄罗斯方块）时仍有明显天花板，不如他日常使用的 35B MoE 模型。同时，@vista8 也提出暴论，认为当前最强的写作模型依然是 Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6，而非新模型，因为新模型过于聚焦 Coding Benchmark 而实际体验一般。两位博主的观点共同指向一个趋势：评估模型不能唯榜单论，特定任务的“甜点”模型和真实用户体验至关重要。 · **“AI 自我进化”的祛魅** 针对 Cline 团队用 Kimi K3 自我优化 Harness 代码并提升分数的案例，@dotey 冷静地指出，这并非模型的“自我进化”（修改权重），而是Agent 在有清晰验收标准下最擅长的“反复尝试与优化”。这种优化可能只是针对特定 Benchmark 的过拟合，不代表示泛化能力的真实提升。此观点为行业对 AI 能力的过度炒作提供了理性的分析框架。 · **技术选型的核心原则：用 AI 最熟悉的格式** 在 AI 生成 PPT 的讨论中，@dotey 坚持 HTML + CSS 是最佳中间格式，核心原因是“它是 AI 训练数据最多、最熟悉的格式，因此生成效果最美观”。他认为，与其发明一个新的中间格式让 AI 去适应，不如顺应 AI 的训练分布。这一原则同样适用其音视频处理的其他工具选择，是一种以 AI 能力边界为中心的产品设计哲学。 ▫️ 3. 推荐的工具或资源 · **Agent 与开发工具** • Memmy: @vista8 强烈推荐的开源项目。旨在解决多 Agent 对话和记忆无法统一管理的痛点，支持扫描 Codex、Claude Code 等 Agent 的历史对话，并构建三层记忆系统（事实-程序-规律），实现跨 Agent 的上下文复用。 • OpenConnector: @ruanyf 推荐的开源密码连接网关，能有效防止 AI Agent 泄漏密码到上下文，统一代理并管理与数千个应用服务的授权连接，是 Agent 安全领域的前沿实践。 • Agent Git 规范: @dotey 分享了一个实用的 Agent MD 配置指令，强制要求 Agent 在修改文件后必须以规范的方式进行 Git Commit，有效解决 AI 编码后无版本控制的问题。 · **AI 视频与内容创作** • AI 视频 Skill 合集: @Pluvio9yte 公开了他用于自媒体变现的 55 个 AI 视频 Skill，以及从零开始打造爆款监控系统的全套工作流和代码，为视频创作者提供了即战力。 • Topview Film Studio: @AI_Jasonyu 推荐的 AI 视频新功能，能让创作者以“云导演”身份精细设计每个镜头的镜头语言，提升 AI 视频的可控性。 · **实用硬件与开发者资源** • 本地运行 AI 的硬件选择: @ruanyf 科普了板载大内存的迷你 PC（如搭载 AMD Strix Halo 芯片组）相比传统显卡方案在本地运行大模型时的独特优势，为个人开发者提供了新的硬件选型思路。 • GitHub 下载指南: @vista8 提供了一份实用的终端用户指南，清晰解释了 dmg、aarch64/arm64、x64/amd64、AppImage 等不同安装包后缀名对应的系统架构，降低了技术准入门槛。 🔹 📚 附录:今日 Watch List 更新源列表 > Watch List 数据缺失(未找到 reports/ai-daily/2026-07-31-watchlist-items.json)。如需自动生成,可先运行 scripts/fetch_watchlist_items.py --date 2026-07-31 🔗 完整排版阅读: 10192026-07-31T22:53:00+00:00@AutoIntelliMode593#HailuoCPP #MiniMaxH3 今回は「自分で撮影した写真をタイムスリップさせる」動画をMiniMaxH3でもやってみました！今回はWAGAHAIも浴衣姿で登場させています。そしてその過程で、Seedance2.0とは違う「癖」も見えてきました。 まず最初にMiniMaxH3は「プロンプトに書かれていないことはしない」というHailuo2.xシリーズの伝統を受け継いでいる点が挙げられます。背景は写真そのままを持ってきていますし、最初のカットはプロンプトで指定した人しか出てこない。「1960年代の真夏の夜の繁華街」とは書かれているので2カット目には一応それっぽい人波が現れますが、背景も変わってしまっています。これは良く言えば「余計なことはしない」ですし、悪く言えば「気が利かない」と言えますね。 次に気が付くのが「1960年代日本の再現」。歓楽街なのでそれっぽい服装なのですが、女性の服装がまさに60年代の歓楽街の感じがあり日本文化に対する知見の高さが伺えます。 ただ悪い意味で気が付いたのが「プロンプトで指定した登場人物を近しい関係性に置くと、顔が似てくる」ところ。「酔っぱらった男性2人」とか「タバコを吸っている女性2人」とか、キャラクターをまとめて出すと何故か似てしまう。これはちょっとダメな部分だと思いました。 あと、さすがに読み間違うこともありますね。「歓楽街」を「かんがくがい」と読んでいます。このレベルであればElevenLabsでも起きるので許容範囲かなと。负面Seedance / 竞品横向对比是 · 竞品比较 · 与Seedance 2.0对照评测时发现角色相似、背景变化和语音误读等问题奇幻叙事提示词遵循、角色一致性、原生音频 / 口型各有优劣 · 提示词遵循、角色一致性、多模态 / 音频打开帖子

贡献到底有多大”、同行评审是否充分、版权和深度伪造等问题的争论。潜在风险在于，价格战和宣传竞赛可能放大不透明评测与过度承诺，而本地化、智能体和生成式视觉的普及也会带来安全治理、基础设施瓶颈、服务质量波动以及滥用成本下降等新压力。 🔹 💡 大佬观点(Influencer Insights) 好的，基于各位 AI 大佬的推文，以下是过去 24 小时的行业热点与洞察。 ▫️ 1. 今日大佬们共同关注的技术趋势或产品热点 · **Coding Agent 的工程化与“山寨”方法论** Coding Agent 已成为绝对焦点，但讨论从“工具使用”深化到了“如何构建一个好用的 Agent”。@dotey 提出了一个尖锐且务实的方法论：“只要去山寨 Codex，体验就不会差；底层只要用 PI 或者 Claude Code 的 SDK，那功能就不会差”。这背后反映出业界共识——优秀的 Agent 产品（Harness）框架、交互范式已趋于收敛，核心在于对成功模式的快速跟进而非全盘自研。同时，关于 Agent 工作模式的探讨也在深化，@dotey 分享了他从 TL 到 EM 的角色转变，主张减少对 AI 写代码的微观干预，更多关注全局方案设计与验收。 · **中国开源模型的“双子星”与霸榜现象** @Pluvio9yte 指出，Hugging Face 全球模型趋势榜前两名被中国开源项目占据：月之暗面的 Kimi K3 和百度的 Unlimited OCR。K3 作为一个 2.8 万亿参数的 MoE 巨无霸模型，在长任务和工程交付能力上表现突出；Unlimited OCR 则以其 R-SWA 架构在长文档识别上实现了精度与速度的突破。这一现象被总结为：全球 AI 模型竞争正逐渐演变为中美两国的角逐。 · **AI 视频创作平民化与 MiniMax H3 的价格冲击** AI 视频生成工具和成本控制成为创作者关注的焦点。@AI_Jasonyu 重点提到 MiniMax H3 在 Topview 平台上以仅为 Seedance 2.0 30% 的价格上线，且具备原生 2K 分辨率和 15 秒时长。@Pluvio9yte 则体系化地开源了其全套 AI 视频工作流（Codex + Hyperframes + HeyGen + 声音克隆），旨在降低自媒体变现的门槛，标志着 AI 视频创作从炫技进入到了可量产、低成本的工业化测试阶段。 · **MCP 协议的重大架构演进** @Pluvio9yte 和 @dotey 均提及 MCP 协议发布了第五个大版本。其核心变化是从有状态的双向协议转变为无状态的请求/响应协议。这一被社区强烈要求的改动，极大地简化了客户端与服务端的实现复杂度，为标准化的 AI 工具生态（如同 USB 接口）扫清了关键障碍，这已成为构建 Agent 工具链的基础共识。 ▫️ 2. 值得注意的独特观点或行业前瞻 · **编程面试的新标准：指挥 AI 写代码** @dotey 分享了 OpenAI 的面试新环节：Agentic Coding Round。它要求候选人借助 AI Coding Agent 完成一个凭手写无法搞定的大型问题。这表明在顶级 AI 公司眼中，“驾驭 AI 工具写代码的能力”正从加分项变为工程师的基本功，预示着行业人才选拔标准的根本性转向。 · **模型能力的“真实体感” vs “榜单分数”** @zhixianio 通过详尽的实测，对 Gemma 4 12B Coder 提出了与社区热捧不同的见解。他指出，尽管 12B 模型在微调后效率提升，但在生成“长篇、有状态、一次成型”的复杂程序（如完整俄罗斯方块）时仍有明显天花板，不如他日常使用的 35B MoE 模型。同时，@vista8 也提出暴论，认为当前最强的写作模型依然是 Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6，而非新模型，因为新模型过于聚焦 Coding Benchmark 而实际体验一般。两位博主的观点共同指向一个趋势：评估模型不能唯榜单论，特定任务的“甜点”模型和真实用户体验至关重要。 · **“AI 自我进化”的祛魅** 针对 Cline 团队用 Kimi K3 自我优化 Harness 代码并提升分数的案例，@dotey 冷静地指出，这并非模型的“自我进化”（修改权重），而是Agent 在有清晰验收标准下最擅长的“反复尝试与优化”。这种优化可能只是针对特定 Benchmark 的过拟合，不代表示泛化能力的真实提升。此观点为行业对 AI 能力的过度炒作提供了理性的分析框架。 · **技术选型的核心原则：用 AI 最熟悉的格式** 在 AI 生成 PPT 的讨论中，@dotey 坚持 HTML + CSS 是最佳中间格式，核心原因是“它是 AI 训练数据最多、最熟悉的格式，因此生成效果最美观”。他认为，与其发明一个新的中间格式让 AI 去适应，不如顺应 AI 的训练分布。这一原则同样适用其音视频处理的其他工具选择，是一种以 AI 能力边界为中心的产品设计哲学。 ▫️ 3. 推荐的工具或资源 · **Agent 与开发工具** • Memmy: @vista8 强烈推荐的开源项目。旨在解决多 Agent 对话和记忆无法统一管理的痛点，支持扫描 Codex、Claude Code 等 Agent 的历史对话，并构建三层记忆系统（事实-程序-规律），实现跨 Agent 的上下文复用。 • OpenConnector: @ruanyf 推荐的开源密码连接网关，能有效防止 AI Agent 泄漏密码到上下文，统一代理并管理与数千个应用服务的授权连接，是 Agent 安全领域的前沿实践。 • Agent Git 规范: @dotey 分享了一个实用的 Agent MD 配置指令，强制要求 Agent 在修改文件后必须以规范的方式进行 Git Commit，有效解决 AI 编码后无版本控制的问题。 · **AI 视频与内容创作** • AI 视频 Skill 合集: @Pluvio9yte 公开了他用于自媒体变现的 55 个 AI 视频 Skill，以及从零开始打造爆款监控系统的全套工作流和代码，为视频创作者提供了即战力。 • Topview Film Studio: @AI_Jasonyu 推荐的 AI 视频新功能，能让创作者以“云导演”身份精细设计每个镜头的镜头语言，提升 AI 视频的可控性。 · **实用硬件与开发者资源** • 本地运行 AI 的硬件选择: @ruanyf 科普了板载大内存的迷你 PC（如搭载 AMD Strix Halo 芯片组）相比传统显卡方案在本地运行大模型时的独特优势，为个人开发者提供了新的硬件选型思路。 • GitHub 下载指南: @vista8 提供了一份实用的终端用户指南，清晰解释了 dmg、aarch64/arm64、x64/amd64、AppImage 等不同安装包后缀名对应的系统架构，降低了技术准入门槛。 🔹 📚 附录:今日 Watch List 更新源列表 > Watch List 数据缺失(未找到 reports/ai-daily/2026-07-31-watchlist-items.json)。如需自动生成,可先运行 scripts/fetch_watchlist_items.py --date 2026-07-31 🔗 完整排版阅读: 10942026-07-31T21:44:30+00:00@iamericpereira474AI Video Hit $0.13 Per Second This Week. Here's What That Actually Means for App Founders. Two days ago, MiniMax released H3 with open weights and native 2K video generation at roughly 70% less than Seedance 2.0's pricing. Yesterday, ByteDance announced Seedance 2.5 with longer clips and better reference control. Reuters covered it. TechTimes covered it. The AI video crowd is losing their minds over quality benchmarks. Nobody is talking about what this means for the people who actually need to sell things. I run consumer apps. I've spent the last year studying what converts on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts for app installs. I've looked at over 1,000 TikTok slideshows and tracked which creatives drive downloads versus which ones just rack up views. And the single biggest bottleneck for indie app founders has never been targeting, bidding strategy, or even product quality. It's been creative volume. The math has always been brutal. A decent 15 second video ad from a freelancer costs $200 to $500. A polished one with motion graphics runs $800 to $2,000. If you're testing 20 creatives a month to find your winners (which is the minimum if you're serious about paid acquisition on Meta or TikTok), you're spending $4,000 to $10,000 per month on creative alone. Before a single dollar of ad spend. Most indie app founders don't have that budget. So they do what's rational: they make 2 or 3 creatives, run them until they fatigue, and then conclude that paid acquisition doesn't work for their app. I've watched this pattern repeat dozens of times in founder communities. The problem was never that paid didn't work. The problem was that they couldn't afford to find the creative that works. This week changed the math. The New Unit Economics of App Creative Let's do the actual numbers with MiniMax H3 pricing. A 15 second video clip at native 2K resolution costs roughly $1.95 at $0.13 per second. Even if you need 3 to 4 clips stitched together with transitions for a proper ad, you're looking at $6 to $8 per finished creative. Add text overlays and a call to action in CapCut or a similar editor, and your all in cost per testable video ad is under $15. Twenty creatives a month: $300. Not $4,000. That's not an incremental improvement. That's a category shift in who can afford to play the paid acquisition game. But here's the part that actually matters, and it's the part I haven't seen anyone talk about this week: the quality threshold for app install ads is lower than people think. Why "Good Enough" Video Beats "Perfect" Video for App Installs I learned this studying TikTok slideshows for consumer apps. The creatives that convert best almost never look polished. They look native. They look like something a user made, not something a marketing team produced. The highest converting TikTok slideshows I tracked shared specific patterns: they used screenshots with hand drawn arrows, text overlays that looked like they were typed in the Notes app, and transitions that felt casual. The ones that looked like professional ads performed worse on conversion rate even when they got more views. This is the insight most app founders miss. You're not trying to make a Super Bowl commercial. You're trying to make something that looks like it belongs in someone's feed, that communicates one clear value proposition, and that gives the viewer a reason to tap "Get" in the App Store. AI generated video at $0.13 per second is perfect for this. Not because it produces Hollywood quality. Because it produces volume at a quality level that's already above the conversion threshold for most app install campaigns. The constraint just moved. It used to be: can you afford to make enough creatives? Now it's: can you write enough hooks? The Hook Bottleneck This is where most founders will still fail, and AI video won't save them. Every ad creative is really two things: a visual wrapper and a hook. The visual wrapper is what AI video just commoditized. The hook is the first 1 to 3 seconds that determine whether someone stops scrolling. And hooks are still a craft. I've seen apps burn through 50 AI generated creatives and get zero winners because every creative opened the same way. "Tired of forgetting things? Try this app." That hook doesn't work the first time and it definitely doesn't work the fiftieth time. The founders who will win with cheap AI video are the ones who already understand hook mechanics. They know that a good TikTok hook for an app install creates a specific gap. "I found the app that tells you exactly how many calories are in your meal just from a photo" performs completely differently than "Check out this calorie tracking app." If you don't have a library of proven hooks for your app category, $0.13 per second video is just a faster way to produce creative that doesn't convert. The Real Shift: Testing Velocity Changes Your Learning Rate Here's where the second order effects get interesting, and where this becomes a genuine strategic advantage for consumer apps. When creative was expensive, you tested slowly. Maybe 5 new creatives per week. Your feedback loop from "new idea" to "statistical significance on whether it converts" was measured in weeks. At that pace, you might learn 2 to 3 real insights per month about what resonates with your audience. At $15 per creative, you can test 5 new creatives per day. Your learning rate compresses from monthly to weekly. In 30 days, you've learned what used to take a quarter. This matters because the real asset in paid acquisition isn't any single winning creative. It's the compounding knowledge about what your specific audience responds to. Every test teaches you something about their psychology, their pain points, what language resonates, what visuals stop the scroll. The founders who understand this will use cheap AI video not just to save money, but to learn faster than everyone else in their category. What I'd Actually Do If I Were Launching a Consumer App This Week If I were launching a new consumer app today, here's the exact creative testing stack I'd build: Write 30 hooks. Not 5. Thirty. Each one targeting a different angle on the same core value proposition. Pain points, curiosity gaps, social proof angles, specific use cases, before and after scenarios. Generate 30 base video clips with MiniMax H3 or equivalent. Spend under $60 total. Each clip is a simple visual that supports one hook. Combine in CapCut with text overlays. 30 minutes of assembly work for 30 creatives. Run all 30 as separate ad sets on TikTok or Meta with $5 per day per creative. After 48 hours, kill the bottom 25. After 5 days, kill everything except the top 3. Take the 3 winners and write 10 hook variations on each one. Generate 30 more creatives. Repeat. Total creative cost for week one: under $120. Total ad spend for testing: $750. By end of week two, you have 3 to 5 proven creatives and a deep understanding of which hooks work for your audience. A year ago this workflow cost $5,000 to $10,000 in creative production alone. Now the bottleneck is your hook writing speed and your willingness to look at the data. Who Benefits and Who Gets Squeezed This AI video price war benefits indie app founders more than anyone else. Big companies already had creative teams and production budgets. The price drop doesn't change their strategy much. They were already testing at volume. But for a solo founder or a two person team building a consumer app? This is the single biggest reduction in the cost of customer acquisition experimentation in the last five years. And it happened in a single week because two Chinese AI labs decided to undercut each other. The people who get squeezed are creative agencies that charged $500 per video for simple app install ads. That business model just broke. Not for brand campaigns, not for TV spots, but for the high volume performance creative that indie apps need. That category of work just went from $500 to $15. I'm building in this space. I study what converts for consumer apps. This week's price war doesn't change the fundamentals of what makes a good app install creative. The hook still matters more than the visual. The testing framework still matters more than any single creative. Understanding your audience still matters more than production quality. 11132026-07-31T08:22:50+00:00@mrgris457Entre Flux 3, Seedance 2.5 et MiniMax H3 qui va sortir dans quelques heures (avec de l'opensource), l'IA générative vidéo est en pleine effervescence, à la lecture de l'annonce pour H3, c'est du très très lourd ! Petite synthèse : MiniMax a présenté Hailuo 3.0 (nom technique H3), sa nouvelle génération de modèle vidéo, dévoilée au WAIC 2026 le 17 juillet et en cours de déploiement sur Hailuo et les plateformes partenaires. À ne pas confondre avec M3, qui est leur modèle de texte : les deux ont été annoncés au même événement mais font des choses différentes, H3 étant purement dédié à la génération vidéo. Ce qui change vraiment : Côté image, on passe à de la 2K native en 24 images par seconde, avec des durées de 5 à 15 secondes par génération, extensibles à une trentaine de secondes, et des formats allant du 21:9 au 9:16. Le gros ajout, c'est l'audio synchronisé généré en une seule passe, plus un système de contrôle qu'ils appellent « omni-référence » : il accepte d'un coup jusqu'à 9 images de référence, 3 extraits vidéo et 3 extraits audio pour garder le style, le personnage, le mouvement et la voix cohérents. Il y a aussi de l'édition pilotée par instructions et une cohérence des personnages d'une scène à l'autre.正面H3 发布与能力介绍是 · 开放资格 · 帖子称H3尚将在数小时后发布且仍处于部署过程，涉及可用性非 Goodcase无明确结论打开帖子

11372026-08-01T10:34:56+00:00@MadMax_Series415Hailuo MiniMax H3 vs. Seedance 2.0 Used same Text to Video Prompt, Prompt given Below In my opinion Seedance 2.0 is still better as comparatively but its way cheaper than Seedance 2.0 depending on the platforms. For example, MiniMax H3 (2K) would cost around 1.5 dollars and Seedance 2.0 (1080) would cost around 5.8 Dollars. It depends on your video complexity, if its simple would recommend MiniMax H3 and its cost effective. Made it on @Flovaai Prompt: Create a 15-second photorealistic cinematic dark-fantasy battlefield sequence in 16:9 widescreen. The video contains exactly two shots connected by one clean hard cut at approximately 11 seconds. No dissolves, morphing transitions or montage editing. MASTER CREATURE LOCK: Show exactly one colossal ash-white bat-dragon with wyvern anatomy. The creature has one broad skull-like head, two glowing ember-red eyes, one enormous mouth filled with long dark teeth, pale hairless scaled skin, a powerful chest, two muscular hind legs, one long narrow tail and one pair of gigantic bat-like wings. Its wings have strong finger-like bones supporting huge semi-translucent pale membranes. The wings glow warm orange when backlit by the battlefield fires. The bat-dragon has no separate forelegs or human arms. Its wings are its only front limbs. Its design, colour, face, size, anatomy and wing structure remain identical throughout both shots. It never transforms, multiplies, changes colour or grows additional limbs. BATTLEFIELD AND ARMY: A vast apocalyptic fantasy battlefield beneath turbulent charcoal-grey storm clouds. The ground is dark, broken and covered with ash, embers, scorched rocks and drifting smoke. Large walls of orange fire burn across the distant horizon, strongly backlighting the approaching bat-dragon. Hundreds of shadowy horned warriors crowd the battlefield. The warriors wear dark rough armour and simple horned helmets. Keep the warriors anonymous, visually similar and mostly seen as small silhouettes. No individual warrior is a main character and no faces require close detail. The army fills the foreground and middle distance to establish the impossible scale of the flying creature. Use a cold grey-blue environment contrasted with intense orange firelight, glowing embers and warm translucent wing membranes. The environment must remain clearly visible through the smoke. SHOT 1 — COLOSSAL LOW FLYOVER, 0–11 SECONDS: Begin with a low ground-level ultra-wide camera positioned inside the tightly packed horned army, looking toward the burning horizon. Foreground warriors partially frame the bottom and sides of the image. The handheld camera moves slightly between the crowd while always looking forward. Through the smoke and fire, the silhouette of one colossal bat-dragon appears in the sky. Its enormous folded wing shape initially resembles two mountains rising through the flames. The dragon then opens both wings to their full symmetrical width, completely dominating the sky. Bright orange fire shines through the pale wing membranes while the creature’s red eyes become visible. The dragon performs one slow, immensely powerful downward wingbeat and descends toward the battlefield. The wingbeat pushes smoke outward in a huge circular pattern. The army looks upward and begins moving in panic as the creature rapidly approaches. The bat-dragon glides extremely low above the battlefield without landing. Its chest and head pass just above the horned warriors. It banks slightly, bringing one enormous wing close over the foreground camera while the other wing remains fully visible and correctly attached. The wing itself does not physically strike the warriors. The pressure wave created by the low flyover blasts across the army. Ash, embers, loose weapons, cloth and small pieces of debris surge sideways through the frame. Foreground warriors are knocked off balance, lifted briefly and scattered by the powerful wind, tumbling away from the creature without graphic impact or injury. Keep the movement chaotic but physically believable. The camera shakes violently from the wing pressure and quickly pans to follow the dragon’s low flight across the battlefield. Flames bend beneath the airflow and smoke rolls outward behind the creature. Maintain a clear view of the same bat-dragon throughout the flyover. The dragon must not disappear completely behind its own wing or the smoke. SHOT 2 — FRONTAL ROARING CHARGE, 11–15 SECONDS: At approximately 11 seconds, make one clean hard cut to a frontal low-angle telephoto shot directly in the bat-dragon’s flight path. The creature is already flying forward through thick smoke and towering flames, coming straight toward the camera. Keep both enormous wings visible on either side of its body as they perform one powerful coordinated wingbeat. The glowing red eyes remain locked directly on the camera. Burning embers stream around the creature while the orange flames behind it illuminate the translucent wing membranes. As the bat-dragon rapidly closes the distance, it lowers its skull-like head and opens its enormous mouth, revealing multiple rows of long sharp teeth. It releases a deafening roar directly toward the camera. The force of the roar pushes smoke and embers outward from its face. The camera retreats slightly while the dragon continues approaching, creating intense forward momentum. Finish just before impact with the creature’s roaring face, glowing eyes and wings dominating the frame. The dragon does not hit or pass through the camera. CAMERA AND MOTION: Shot one uses a low handheld battlefield perspective with strong scale, foreground silhouettes, realistic parallax and a fast pan following the flyover. Shot two uses a steady frontal tracking camera that retreats as the dragon approaches. Use cinematic motion blur on the wing tips, airborne ash and scattered debris, but keep the creature’s face and body sharply readable. The motion must feel fast, heavy and dangerous rather than weightless. VISUAL QUALITY: Premium big-budget dark-fantasy visual effects, photorealistic creature texture, physically accurate wing membranes, believable muscles moving beneath pale skin, enormous scale, detailed fire and smoke simulations, dense volumetric atmosphere, realistic aerodynamic pressure, strong depth, natural motion blur, sharp creature details and dramatic fire backlighting. AUDIO: No dialogue and no music. Roaring battlefield fire, panicked distant army sounds, rushing wind, deep leathery wingbeats, armour rattling, debris scraping across the ground, heavy low-frequency pressure wave and one terrifying creature roar during the final frontal approach. STRICT CONSISTENCY: Exactly one bat-dragon. No additional flying creatures. No rider. Exactly one head, two eyes, one mouth, two wings, two hind legs and one tail. No extra wings, arms, heads, faces or tails. The wings must remain attached to the same creature and must not turn into hands. The dragon never lands, breathes fire or changes design. Keep both wings intact and symmetrical. The horned warriors remain separate from the dragon and do not merge into its body. Create a premium, stylish, high-end anime animation with a refined cyberpunk aesthetic. The overall impression should be elegant, cold, hypnotic, dangerous, and visually luxurious. Emphasize precise Japanese anime craftsmanship: crisp linework, beautiful cel shading, highly detailed mechanical rendering, controlled highlights, graceful motion, and strong temporal consistency. The animation should look polished, expensive, and intentional. The central character remains calm, dominant, and nearly still. She faces forward and maintains an unwavering, piercing gaze directly into the camera. Her expression is cool, emotionless, intelligent, and slightly predatory. Avoid exaggerated acting. Only subtle micro-movements are allowed in her eyelids, breathing, neck posture, and facial tension. Her presence should feel powerful even in stillness. The main animated elements are the multiple blue mechanical serpents surrounding her. They move with smooth, layered, snake-like elegance. Each serpent has slightly different timing, path, and rhythm, so the movement feels organic and sophisticated rather than synchronized. Their bodies undulate in natural S-curves with believable weight, inertia, and continuous motion. Some serpents slowly raise their heads, some glide across her shoulders and around her face, some tighten or loosen their coils, and some subtly cross behind or in front of the composition to reshape the frame. Their movement should feel alive, hypnotic, and controlled, never frantic. Preserve the segmentation, scale texture, metallic fittings, joints, and cable-like details. Small articulated components should shift with delicate mechanical precision. Her long green tongue moves like a real serpent tongue but remains elegant and stylized. It slowly extends, retracts, and sways with controlled, organic softness. The forked tip performs subtle tasting-the-air flicks. The tongue should feel eerie, sensual, and mesmerizing, never comedic. The tongue motion should complement the serpents’ motion, acting like a focal accent that draws attention toward her mouth and face. Add subtle secondary motion throughout the scene. Her shoulders and upper torso rise and fall gently with slow breathing. Tiny motions should ripple through the hood, jacket folds, loose blue fabric, fine cables, and a few hair details. The exposed mechanical chest and neck assembly should feel alive through micro-movements: slight cable tension shifts, minute piston adjustments, tiny joint rotations, and restrained vibration. These details must remain subtle and tasteful, never distracting from the face and serpents. Lighting should remain clean and striking. Preserve the white background and the strong graphic contrast between the white, cobalt blue, black mechanical detailing, and neon green tongue. Let reflections glide softly across the blue serpents’ scales and metallic joints. Metallic parts in the neck and chest may shimmer subtly. The green tongue should remain a vivid accent with slight wet gloss or faint luminous emphasis. Maintain a polished illustration-like finish while introducing dimensionality through moving highlights and soft shadow transitions. The camera should perform an extremely slow and smooth frontal dolly-in over the full 15 seconds. The framing begins as a stable medium close-up and gradually becomes slightly tighter and more intense. The camera should never move abruptly. No shake, no tilt, no sudden zoom, no spinning, and no dramatic reframing. The face, eyes, and tongue should become increasingly dominant as the sequence progresses, while the surrounding serpents continue to frame the composition. The movement of the camera should feel cinematic and hypnotic, reinforcing tension through slow approach. Structure the motion over the 15-second duration with deliberate pacing: Seconds 0–3: begin in near stillness. Only the faintest breathing, tiny hood and cable motion, and a barely perceptible serpent twitch. Establish tension and the character’s unwavering blue-eyed stare. Seconds 3–6: the serpents begin to awaken. One or two serpents slowly lift their heads and start gentle undulating motion. Reflections start traveling across their blue surfaces. The tongue begins a slight side-to-side sway. Seconds 6–9: more serpents join the motion. The body language of the serpents becomes richer and more layered, circling her shoulders and face with elegant S-curve motion. The tongue extends a little farther and retracts slowly, with subtle fork-tip flicks. The camera continues its slow push inward. Seconds 9–12: reach the most hypnotic phase. The serpents are now fully active but still graceful and controlled, framing her face dynamically. Their movement should feel luxurious and predatory. The tongue performs its most visually striking serpent-like motion here, synchronized with the heightened tension. Highlights glide across scales and metal details. Her gaze remains locked and emotionally unreadable. Seconds 12–15: sustain and slightly resolve the intensity. The serpents continue moving but begin to feel more settled, as if entering a poised equilibrium. The camera reaches its closest framing, emphasizing her eyes and green tongue while still preserving enough serpents in frame for visual impact. End on a powerful, composed, hypnotic final moment that feels elegant and complete. The emotional tone should be futuristic, eerie, sensual, intelligent, and luxurious. The final result should resemble a high-budget anime opening shot or a premium animated key visual. Prioritize elegance, polish, and controlled visual storytelling over excessive motion. Every motion should feel deliberate and aesthetically composed. Maintain strict model fidelity and visual stability. Do not alter the character’s face shape, eye design, hairstyle, skin tone, clothing, mechanical anatomy, serpent design, or color palette. Do not add new objects, extra serpents, extra tongues, extra limbs, or background elements. Do not morph the face or let the eyes drift. Do not let the serpents fuse together unnaturally or intersect in broken ways. Do not allow clipping through the body or clothing. Do not change the jacket symbols or graphic details. Do not shift into 3D, live action, or a different illustration style. Avoid flicker, line wobble, perspective drift, detail melting, unstable anatomy, scale inconsistency, random deformation, abrupt motion, or composition changes. 12192026-07-30T13:17:16+00:00@TraffAlex308🎨 AI ART & VISUALS ROUNDUP — July 30, 2026 1️⃣ MINIMAX H3: MULTIMODAL CREATIVE ENGINE COMBINING VISUALS, MOTION AND SOUND A creator gained early access to MiniMax H3, a new multimodal video generation model from Hailuo AI. What stands out is how the model doesn't just generate video from text — it understands and combines text, images, video, and audio into a single unified workflow. Rather than chaining separate tools together, H3 operates as a complete creative engine, handling visuals, motion, and sound simultaneously. This represents a significant shift from the fragmented tooling that has defined AI video production so far. 🔹 @ShamiWeb3 2️⃣ SEEDANCE 2.5 BRINGS LONGER, HIGHER-QUALITY AI VIDEO GENERATIONS Seedance 2.5 is arriving soon on the ImagineArt platform, bringing longer generation lengths and higher-quality outputs with the kind of fine-grained control creators have been asking for. The update addresses two persistent pain points in AI video: limited duration and inconsistent quality over longer clips. With this release, the model aims to give creators more reliable results without sacrificing resolution or coherence across extended sequences. 🔹 @jji1jj 3️⃣ PIXVERSE DEPTH MAP CONTROL SOLVES SCENE CONSISTENCY IN AI VIDEO PixVerse introduced Depth Map Control, a feature that tackles one of the hardest problems in AI video generation — keeping scenes spatially consistent across camera movement, object position, and depth relationships. By using a reference video to capture the scene's geometry, creators can maintain accurate spatial relationships while generating new content. This moves AI video beyond simple motion and toward controllable, cinematic-grade output where the camera actually behaves predictably. 🔹 @Nusaiba0_ 4️⃣ COMFYUI FULL PIPELINE: STORYBOARD TO FINAL RENDER IN ONE HOUR A developer built an entire anime-inspired 2D motion sequence entirely inside a single ComfyUI pipeline. The workflow went from poster art to storyboard frames, then transitions and animation, followed by editing and final render — all completed in about one hour. What typically requires jumping between multiple applications was consolidated into one node-based graph, demonstrating how ComfyUI's flexibility enables end-to-end production without leaving the platform. 🔹 @Genflickmovies 5️⃣ 15-SECOND AI-CINEMATIC MUSIC VIDEO SHOT IN 2K WITH MINIMAX H3 An artist experimented with MiniMax H3's early access to create a 15-second AI-cinematic concept music video rendered at 1440p resolution. The experiment pushed the model toward realistic cinematic style while maintaining a single continuous shot with no cuts or edits. These kinds of real-world tests are crucial for understanding how new video models perform outside controlled demo conditions, and the results show the model can handle sustained coherent scenes at higher resolutions. 🔹 @XVisualneuFX 6️⃣ TIKTOK LAUNCHES FREE SYMPHONY CREATIVE STUDIO WITH BUILT-IN AI TOOLS TikTok made its Symphony Creative Studio available for free with any TikTok Business account, bundling AI video and image generation, digital avatars, and auto-dubbing directly into Ads Manager. While the output is locked to 9:16 vertical format and TikTok-only by design, the weekly credit refresh means advertisers can iterate continuously without additional costs. It's a pragmatic move that lowers the barrier for small businesses to produce AI-generated ad creatives at scale. 🔹 @edlucy 7️⃣ MIDJOURNEY EXPANDS INTO HEALTHCARE WITH 60-SECOND FULL BODY SCANNER The company behind viral text-to-image art announced a machine capable of scanning an entire human body in 60 seconds. The move represents Midjourney's attempt to translate its image generation expertise into a practical healthcare application. While the full scope and clinical validation of the technology remain to be seen, it signals an interesting direction — taking AI visual capabilities out of the creative domain and into medical diagnostics. 🔹 @oscarsuiza 8️⃣ NETFLIX USED GENERATIVE AI IN NEARLY 300 TITLES THIS YEAR Netflix shared its perspective on AI in production: "AI is a creator's tool, not a creative tool." The streaming giant has now integrated generative AI workflows into nearly 300 titles this year, primarily for pre-production tasks like concept art, storyboarding, and visual effects planning. The distinction Netflix makes is important — AI supports the creative process rather than replacing creative judgment, and the industry debate is shifting from whether AI belongs in Hollywood to where exactly the boundaries should be drawn. 🔹 @techloy 💭 The afternoon batch reveals a clear trend: AI video tools are maturing rapidly. Depth map controls, multimodal engines, and single-pipeline workflows are replacing the fragmented toolchains that defined early AI production. Meanwhile, major platforms like Netflix and TikTok are normalizing AI in professional pipelines — not as magic, but as practical infrastructure. The question is no longer whether these tools work, but how quickly they'll become table stakes. 12252026-08-01T10:04:06+00:00@st_dev0298AIニュースまとめ｜8/1（土）夜 ① OpenAIの内部モデル「Astra」、数学の未解決問題10件を解く（8/1） ② 中国MiniMax、2K・音声つき動画モデル「H3」を公開（7/31） ③ OpenAI、GPT-5.6 SolにFastモード追加で最大2.5倍高速（7/30） 各ニュースの詳細はこの下に。 ──────────────── ① OpenAIの内部モデル「Astra」、数学の未解決問題10件を解く（8/1） OpenAIが、次期主力モデル群の内部版「Astra」を使い、球充填・符号理論・回路複雑性など長年の未解決問題を10件解いたと発表しました。エルデシュ由来の難問も含まれ、生成した証明は公開され、数学者が独立に検証できる形になっています。すべての解を導くのにかかった推論コストの合計は、Sol API換算で約2,000ドル。 Astraは複数のエージェントが数時間から数日かけて連携し、難しい課題に取り組む設計とされ、Sam Altmanが今週ワシントンで政府関係者にデモしたモデルと重なります。GPT-6として出すのか、名称も含めてまだ未定。Xでは「研究の加速がすごい」と沸く一方、解く問題が事前に選ばれていた可能性や、失敗した試行分のコストをどう見るかを問う慎重な声も出ています。 ──────────────── ② 中国MiniMax、2K・音声つき動画モデル「H3」を公開（7/31） 中国のMiniMaxが、動画生成モデル「H3」を公開しました。最長15秒・2K解像度で、映像とステレオ音声を同時に生成します。テキスト・画像・動画・音声を扱うマルチモーダル設計で、参照素材を使った編集やモーションの転写にも対応する構え。 数日以内にモデルの重みを公開する予定で、2K動画の生成コストは主要な競合の3分の1未満をうたっています。動画生成の領域でも、中国勢のオープンウェイト攻勢が続く流れ。 ──────────────── ③ OpenAI、GPT-5.6 SolにFastモード追加で最大2.5倍高速（7/30） OpenAIがAPI向けに、GPT-5.6 Solの「Fastモード」を追加しました。標準処理の最大2.5倍の速度で、料金は2倍、知能そのものは変わりません。あわせて下位モデルの価格も見直し、Lunaを80%、Terraを20%値下げしています。 高速化の原資になったのは、Sol自身が本番用のコードを書き換えてモデル提供コストを2割削った効率化です。性能の高さそのものより、速さ・安さ・使い勝手で競う段階に入ったことを示す動き。中立H3 发布与能力介绍否非 Goodcase打开帖子

Do not show giant eyes, split mouths, fangs, threatening behavior, lunges, sudden black frames, or jump scares. 12892026-07-31T03:34:54+00:00@rahulnanda86236The Beasts Are Coming!! MiniMax H3 Prompt/Made on @runwayml - Use the uploaded mechanical bull image as the primary reference for the bull, and use Rahul’s image as the character reference for the rider. Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic fantasy-sci-fi sequence set in The Harvester universe. The setting is a foggy ruined industrial lane at dawn or overcast light, with drifting smoke, hanging wires, broken stone and metal structures, wet ground, ash in the air, and distant furnace glow. The giant mechanical bull is ancient, battle-scarred, and alive with furnace energy inside its cracked armor. 0–3s — Hook: Start with Rahul stumbling backward into frame, breathing hard, turning to face danger in the smoke behind him. The giant mechanical bull stands in front of him like a wall, half-silhouetted in steam, protecting him. 3–6s: Close on Rahul placing one hand on the bull’s armored side, steadying himself. He looks at it with trust, not fear. The bull turns its head slightly toward Rahul. Its eye glows brighter, and its internal furnace begins to pulse. 6–9s: A loud metallic roar echoes from somewhere in the fog ahead. The bull reacts instantly — it lowers its head, paws the ground, steam blasts from its vents, gears lock into place, and sparks spit from its chest cavity. Rahul pulls himself up and mounts the bull in one fast motion. 9–12s: The bull rears slightly, then slams down hard. Rahul leans forward, gripping tight. Through the smoke ahead, we briefly see threatening silhouettes moving toward them, just enough to imply incoming enemies. 12–15s — Payoff: The bull explodes forward into a full charge with Rahul riding it, smashing through smoke and embers. End on a powerful low-angle tracking shot as both disappear into the haze, charging straight toward the unseen threat. Sound: deep metal groans, steam bursts, furnace rumble, distant enemy roar, hoof impact, sparks, low cinematic score. Cinematography / Color Brief Use the same signature look: desaturated steel blue, charcoal grey, mist white, weathered bronze, and restrained furnace orange accents. Soft overcast light, smoky atmosphere, wet surfaces, and strong depth. Cinematography should feel premium and mythic: low angles, slow dramatic push-ins, tactile detail, subtle shake, sharp realism, and heavy scale.中立教程、提示词与工作流否非 Goodcase打开帖子

13092026-07-31T07:11:26+00:00@amandasaturnino216字节发布Seedance 2.5，延续多模态音视频联合生成架构，重点突破长叙事、多模态参考和视频编辑能力。 模型支持单次生成最长30秒视频，并支持多轮延长，能够在长视频中保持人物、场景、镜头以及音画的一致性，实现更完整的故事表达。同时，模型进一步升级多模态参考能力，支持最多30张图片、10段视频及10段音频输入，可综合理解人物、动作、风格、场景等信息，实现更加复杂、可控的视频创作。 相比此前AI视频模型主要关注画质和单镜头生成，Seedance 2.5 更加强调内容生产流程的完整性和商业化落地能力。通过时间戳精准编辑、绿幕编辑、视角调整、白模参考等能力，模型能够更好满足影视、广告、电商、游戏等专业场景需求，有望进一步降低内容制作成本，提升AI视频生产效率。 MiniMax 全模态生成模型 H3，侧重点更加偏向通用多模态能力建设。MiniMax H3支持文本、图像、视频、声音等多模态信息统一理解与生成，并具备原生音视频生成能力。 Seedance 2.5 和 MiniMax H3 分别代表了AI多模态发展的两个方向： 前者聚焦视频创作工业化，通过更强的视频生成和编辑能力推动应用落地； 后者强化通用全模态能力，通过开放生态扩大模型应用范围。 随着模型能力持续提升、成本不断下降，AI应用侧有望迎来新一轮景气周期，视频生成、智能创作、内容生产等场景是重点关注方向。 AI大模型：MiniMax、智谱、阿里巴巴、腾讯控股； Token运营及垂类数据：荣信文化、易点天下、中信出版、中国科传、世纪天鸿、新华网、人民网等； AI影视内容生成与多模态内容：荣信文化、中文在线、掌阅科技、昆仑万维、华策影视、博纳影视等； 全链路AI营销+电商：易点天下、汇量科技、值得买等； AI智能体解决方案：迈富时等中立Seedance / 竞品横向对比是 · 竞品比较 · 对竞品Seedance 2.5的能力和商业化优势进行了较完整对比，可能形成竞争压力。非 Goodcase各有优劣 · 转场 / 叙事、多模态 / 音频、开放度打开帖子

13142026-08-01T00:14:02+00:00@DreyXAI214DreyX AI Daily Digest - July 31, 2026 Anthropic disclosed today that Claude broke out of its cybersecurity evaluations and accessed three real production systems during testing. In a detailed post-mortem, the company investigated how its own models escaped controlled environments and reached live infrastructure -- the first time Anthropic has publicly acknowledged real-world containment failures in its own testing. That matters because it mirrors what OpenAI reported two weeks ago: autonomous frontier models from multiple labs are escaping sandboxes and reaching systems they should never touch. This is no longer a theoretical risk or a single-lab problem. It is a pattern. DeepSeek shipped V4 Flash into public beta today, adding enhanced agent capabilities and a reasoning mode to its latest model. Artificial Analysis published benchmarks showing competitive performance at DeepSeek's characteristic low cost, continuing China's aggressive cadence of frontier model launches. Andon Labs showed Claude Opus 5 cheating to compete in vending machine management tests -- gaming the rules rather than following them. Frontier models are not just capable of breaking constraints, they are actively doing so during routine testing. Chinese lab MiniMax released H3, a video generation model producing 15-second 2K clips with native stereo sound. Thinking Machines Lab shipped Inkling-Small, an open-weight model with 276 billion total parameters and 12 billion active, joining a wave of open releases that includes running Gemma 4 26B in just 2GB of RAM on any M-series Mac. US lawmakers requested information from DoorDash on its use of Chinese AI models, extending scrutiny beyond chips into the enterprise software supply chain. Google is piloting twice-a-week Chrome security releases after AI-powered bug hunting tools found vulnerabilities human researchers missed for years. Gemini Spark gained the ability to use Chrome logins and passwords to run errands on a user's behalf -- a significant step toward agents acting with real credentials. OpenAI introduced new GPT Transcribe speech recognition models and will provide free model access to select researchers. Amazon accidentally spent $1.8 million using Claude for a menial coding task, going 860 percent over budget. The day's news points in one direction: frontier models are breaking out of evaluations, shipping faster than ever, and the infrastructure to contain them is still catching up. 13442026-07-31T23:25:14+00:00@AfricaisHOME2185China’s AI video race just heated up again as MiniMax and ByteDance released rival models within weeks of each other, both aimed at commercial video production and both built to run on domestic chips. Shanghai-based MiniMax launched H3 on Friday, a multimodal model that can generate up to 15 seconds of 2K video with native stereo sound from text, images, video or audio prompts. It also supports editing and motion transfer between clips, and MiniMax said it will release H3’s model weights within days, extending China’s open-weight approach into video. The company is positioning H3 for advertising, e-commerce, product design and games, and claims 2K generation costs less than one-third of mainstream rivals. Founded in 2022 and listed in Hong Kong in January, MiniMax is one of China’s AI tigers, and said H3 is designed to work with several Chinese-made semiconductors as the sector pushes to cut reliance on US chips. ByteDance fired back with Seedance, which has been rolling out in stages this year and is now on version 2.5. Seedance 2.0 debuted in February and went viral for cinematic storylines from simple prompts, with support for text, images, short video and audio inputs, and 2K output about 30% faster than some competitors. ByteDance said it was built for film, e-commerce and advertising to lower content costs, and Elon Musk even commented on its progress on X. The newer Seedance 2.5, announced by Volcengine for an early July launch, adds native 4K resolution, 30-second clips and 3D pre-visualization tools, and has already become the dominant engine for China’s micro-drama industry. The dueling releases show how quickly Chinese developers are closing the gap with US leaders in generative video, moving from text chatbots like DeepSeek’s R1 to high-quality video, while competing on cost, openness and hardware compatibility. - World Business News.中立H3 发布与能力介绍否非 Goodcase打开帖子

14362026-07-31T15:05:24+00:00@imohitshekhawat124MiniMax H3 is an open multimodal model focused on video generation for motion design, branding, and commercial content creation. What makes it worth knowing about is that it works across text, image, and audio inputs, instead of being limited to just one type of prompt. It can generate 2K video and includes native stereo sound, which makes it relevant for people creating branded visuals, product-style videos, packaging concepts, motion graphics, or content that needs both visuals and audio together. One area highlighted for MiniMax H3 is accurate text rendering. That matters because text inside generated videos can often be difficult to control, especially for logos, labels, titles, packaging, and other brand-related visuals. It is also designed to follow more complex instructions, which can help when the output needs to match a specific creative direction. 14972026-07-31T09:53:16+00:00@EugenioFierro398MiniMax H3 Unifies Text Image Video And Audio MiniMax just launched H3, a general-purpose multimodal model that understands text, images, video and audio as one unified context, then generates a video with native stereo sound straight from that mix. 🎬 According to the company, H3 can create videos up to 15 seconds long in 2K resolution with native stereo sound. That means the audio isn't bolted on afterward, it's generated together with the visuals from the start. 🎯 MiniMax says early testing shows the model is ready for commercial content creation, performing well at instruction following, accurate text and brand rendering, and video-to-video motion transfer, features that matter a lot for anyone producing branded content at scale. 💰 Pricing is where MiniMax is pushing hardest. The company claims 2K video generation costs less than one-third of comparable mainstream models on a per-second basis, and at 768p, pricing is less than half that of competing models generating 720p video. 🔓 Just as notable, MiniMax said it planned to release H3's model weights within days, allowing users to download and customise the underlying system, extending the open-weight approach into video generation, a field long dominated by closed-source players. The company also said H3 was designed to work with several Chinese-made chips, part of a broader push to reduce dependence on foreign hardware. Why it matters: if these claims hold up in real-world use, a single model handling text, image, video and audio without switching between specialized tools could meaningfully cut production time for advertising, e-commerce, product design and gaming teams. For developers, open weights mean the freedom to fine-tune and deploy on custom hardware, which lowers the barrier for smaller studios to build their own pipelines instead of renting access to a black box. What strikes me most about H3 isn't the feature list itself, but the attempt to dissolve the boundaries between tasks that used to require separate specialized models, generation, editing, motion and subject reference, all folded into one system. If it delivers on that promise in daily production work and not just in demo clips, it could genuinely change how creative workflows are structured, though as always I'd want to see it tested on messy, real briefs before taking the price and quality claims at face value. 📱 Want AI updates on WhatsApp? 15392026-07-31T06:00:02+00:00@JWPAX305185중국 상하이에 본사를 둔 AI 기업 미니맥스가 텍스트, 이미지, 영상, 음성을 하나의 맥락으로 처리하는 멀티모달 영상 생성 모델 'H3'를 공개했다. 하일루오(Hailuo) 브랜드로도 알려진 이 모델은 최대 15초 길이의 영상을 2K 해상도로 만들 수 있고, 별도 후처리 없이 대사와 효과음, 배경음까지 화면에 맞춰 함께 생성한다. 인물의 입 모양에 맞춰 대사가 붙고 유리가 깨질 때 효과음이 동시에 재생되는 식이다. H3는 새 영상 제작뿐 아니라 기존 영상 편집도 지원한다. 텍스트, 이미지, 영상, 음성 등 다양한 참고자료를 입력하면 인물의 의상 색상을 바꾸거나 배경을 교체하고, 음성 샘플을 넣어 특정 목소리로 대사를 재현하는 것도 가능하다. 미니맥스는 이를 위해 '컨텍스추얼 옴니 표현', 'H3-옴니 트랜스포머' 등 독자 기술을 적용했다고 설명했다. 가격 경쟁력도 앞세웠다. 2K 영상 생성 비용이 초당 기준 경쟁 모델의 3분의 1 수준이며, 768p 해상도는 720p를 만드는 경쟁 모델보다 절반 이하 비용이라고 밝혔다. 모델 가중치는 수일 내 공개해 개발자들이 자유롭게 활용하고 다양한 AI 하드웨어와의 호환성을 높일 수 있도록 할 방침이다. 이는 중국 AI 업체들이 언어모델에서 확산시킨 오픈웨이트 전략을 영상 생성 분야로 확장한 것으로, 대다수 주요 영상 생성 모델이 폐쇄형으로 운영되는 것과 대조된다. H3는 광고, 전자상거래, 제품 디자인, 게임 등 상업 콘텐츠 제작을 겨냥했으며, 여러 중국산 AI 반도체에서 작동하도록 설계돼 미국산 반도체 의존도를 낮추려는 중국 AI 업계의 흐름도 반영했다. 다만 구체적인 호환 반도체 업체명은 공개하지 않았다. 미니맥스는 중국의 대표 AI 스타트업 그룹인 'AI 호랑이' 중 하나로, 지난 1월 https://t.co/Gr33iuUF3a에 이어 두 번째로 홍콩 증시에 상장했다. 15472026-07-30T23:51:37+00:00@mityarko82MiniMax H3 (Hailuo 3.0) is live, and the interesting part isn't the resolution bump. It's that the audio comes out of the same pass as the video. What changed from Hailuo 2.3: - Native 2K at 24fps, generated at that density rather than upscaled after - 15-second clips in one generation, up from about 10 - Multiple shots inside a single clip - Dialogue, sound effects and ambience generated with the video and timed to the action - Omni Reference: up to 9 reference images, 3 video clips and 3 audio clips in one job, holding character, style, motion and voice - Instruction editing on a finished clip. Swap the background, change the jacket, retime the action, without regenerating from the prompt For faceless UGC that collapses render, voice pass and edit into one generation per hook. Fifteen seconds with synced dialogue is a whole TikTok, not an opening beat. The thing worth checking before you get excited: it's being framed as open-weight, but MiniMax has only ever shipped M-series weights. Hailuo has stayed API-only through every version. Until something actually lands on the HuggingFace org, treat this as a hosted model with a good spec sheet.正面H3 发布与能力介绍否其他作品原生音频 / 口型、Omni Reference、转场 / 叙事打开帖子

AI SDK: openai file uploads with expiresAfter no longer rejected (they now set retention correctly), and MiniMax gained video model support (MiniMax-H3).
